sentences.zh: 會毛裡孩再乞通貢，而別部長孛魯乃亦遣人來朝。

translations.literal: It happened that Molihai again begged to resume tribute, while the chieftain of another division, Berenai, also sent men to court.
translations.idiomatic: Molihai was again petitioning to resume tribute, and Berenai, chieftain of another division, also sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 帝許之，詔永等駐軍塞上。

translations.literal: The emperor granted this and ordered Yong and the others to encamp their armies on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted their requests and ordered Zhu Yong and the others to hold their armies on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，給事中程萬里上言：「毛裡孩久不朝貢，窺伺邊疆，其情叵測。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year Supervising Secretary Cheng Wanli memorialized: "Molihai has long failed to come to court with tribute and watches the frontier with ill intent; his designs are hard to fathom.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year Supervising Secretary Cheng Wanli memorialized: "Molihai has long neglected tribute missions and watches our frontier with ill intent. His designs are impossible to read.

sentences.zh: 然臣度其有可敗者三。

translations.literal: Yet your servant considers that he has three points of vulnerability.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I believe he has three weaknesses we can exploit.

sentences.zh: 近我邊地才二三日程，彼客我主，一也。

translations.literal: Our frontier is only two or three days' march away; they are guests and we are hosts—this is the first.
translations.idiomatic: Our frontier is only two or three days' march away—they are intruders on our ground, and we are the hosts. That is the first.

sentences.zh: 兼併諸部，馳驅不息，既驕且疲，二也。

translations.literal: He has annexed the tribes and drives his men without rest; they are both arrogant and exhausted—this is the second.
translations.idiomatic: He has swallowed up the tribes and drives his men without rest; they are at once overbearing and worn down. That is the second.

sentences.zh: 比來散逐水草，部落四分，兵力不一，三也。

translations.literal: Of late they have scattered to follow grass and water, and the tribes are divided four ways with forces unequal—this is the third.
translations.idiomatic: Lately they have scattered to follow pasture and water, and the tribes are split four ways with unequal strength. That is the third.

sentences.zh: 宜選精兵二萬，每三千人為一軍，統以驍將，嚴其賞罰，使探毛裡孩所在，潛師搗之，破之必矣。

translations.literal: We should choose twenty thousand picked troops, form units of three thousand each under fierce generals, enforce rewards and punishments strictly, send scouts to locate Molihai, and strike him with a hidden force; he will surely be broken.
translations.idiomatic: We should choose twenty thousand picked troops, divide them into units of three thousand under bold commanders, enforce discipline strictly, locate Molihai, and strike him with a concealed force. He can be broken.

sentences.zh: 」帝壯之，而不能用。

translations.literal: " The emperor was impressed but could not adopt the plan.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was impressed but did not act on the plan.

sentences.zh: 冬寇延綏。

translations.literal: In winter they raided Yan-Sui.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they raided Yan-Sui.

sentences.zh: 明年春再入。

translations.literal: The next spring they entered again.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they entered again.

sentences.zh: 守將許寧等輒擊敗之。

translations.literal: The defending generals Xu Ning and others promptly attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The defending generals Xu Ning and others promptly attacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 冬復糾三衛入寇，延綏、榆林大擾。

translations.literal: In winter they again gathered the Three Guards and entered to raid; Yan-Sui and Yulin were greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they again rallied the Three Guards and raided; Yan-Sui and Yulin were thrown into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 六年春，大同巡撫王越遣游擊許寧擊敗之；

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year Datong Grand Coordinator Wang Yue dispatched Guerrilla Commander Xu Ning to attack and defeat them;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year Datong Grand Coordinator Wang Yue sent Guerrilla Commander Xu Ning to attack and defeat them;

sentences.zh: 楊信等亦大破之於胡柴氵冓。

translations.literal: Yang Xin and others also inflicted a great defeat on them at Huchai Gully.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xin and others also crushed them at Huchai Gully.

sentences.zh: 時孛魯乃與斡羅出合別部加思蘭、孛羅忽亦入據河套，為久居計。

translations.literal: At this time Berenai and Wolochu joined with Qojasan and Boluohu of another division; they too entered and seized the Ordos bend, intending to settle there for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Berenai and Wolochu joined Qojasan and Boluohu of another division, and they too entered the Ordos bend intending to settle there permanently.

sentences.zh: 延綏告急，帝命永為將軍，以王越參贊軍務，使禦敵。

translations.literal: Yan-Sui reported an emergency; the emperor ordered Yong to serve as general, with Wang Yue assisting in military affairs, to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Yan-Sui sent urgent reports, and the emperor appointed Zhu Yong general, with Wang Yue to assist in military affairs, to meet the enemy.

sentences.zh: 永至，數以捷聞，越等皆升賞，論功永世侯，而敵據套自如。

translations.literal: When Yong arrived he repeatedly reported victories; Yue and the others were all promoted and rewarded, and for his merit Yong was enfeoffed as a hereditary marquis, yet the enemy held the bend as before.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhu Yong arrived he repeatedly reported victories; Wang Yue and the others were promoted and rewarded, and Yong was enfeoffed as a hereditary marquis for his merit—yet the enemy still held the bend.

sentences.zh: 七年春，永上戰守二策，廷議以糧匱馬乏，難於進剿，請命邊將慎守禦以圖萬全。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year Yong submitted two plans, one for attack and one for defense; court discussion held that grain was scarce and horses exhausted and that a forward campaign would be difficult, and requested that frontier generals be ordered to defend carefully and seek complete security.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year Zhu Yong submitted plans for both attack and defense. Court discussion held that supplies were short and horses worn out, making a forward campaign impractical, and urged frontier generals to hold the line carefully instead.

sentences.zh: 於是吏部侍郎葉盛巡邊，偕延綏巡撫餘子俊及越議築邊牆，設立台堡。

translations.literal: Thereupon Vice Minister of Personnel Ye Sheng toured the frontier and, together with Yan-Sui Grand Coordinator Yu Zijun and Wang Yue, discussed building a frontier wall and establishing beacon towers and fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Vice Minister of Personnel Ye Sheng toured the frontier and, with Yan-Sui Grand Coordinator Yu Zijun and Wang Yue, planned the construction of a frontier wall and a network of beacon towers and fortresses.

sentences.zh: 冬，敵入塞，參將錢亮敗績，越等不能救。

translations.literal: In winter the enemy entered the frontier; Assistant Commander Qian Liang was defeated, and Yue and the others could not rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the enemy broke through the frontier; Assistant Commander Qian Liang was defeated, and Wang Yue and the others could not reach him in time.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書白圭請擇遣大將軍專事敵，會盛還，越亦赴京計事，乃集廷議，請大發兵搜套。

translations.literal: Minister of War Bai Gui requested that a great general be chosen and dispatched to deal exclusively with the enemy; when Ye Sheng returned and Yue also came to the capital to discuss affairs, the court assembled for deliberation and requested a major mobilization to sweep the bend.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Bai Gui asked that a senior general be chosen to focus solely on the enemy. When Ye Sheng returned and Wang Yue came to the capital as well, the court met and called for a major expedition to drive the raiders from the bend.

sentences.zh: 帝以武靖侯趙輔為將軍，節制諸路，王越仍督師。

translations.literal: The emperor made Wujing Marquis Zhao Fu general with authority over all routes; Wang Yue continued to direct the army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Wujing Marquis Zhao Fu general with authority over all frontier routes, while Wang Yue continued to direct operations.

sentences.zh: 敵大入延綏，輔不能御，遂召還，以寧晉伯劉聚代之，聚亦未有功。

translations.literal: The enemy launched a major raid into Yan-Sui; Fu could not repel them, and was recalled; Ningjin Earl Liu Ju replaced him, but Ju also achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy launched a major raid into Yan-Sui. Zhao Fu could not repel them and was recalled; Ningjin Earl Liu Ju replaced him, but he too won no success.

sentences.zh: 而毛裡孩、孛魯乃、斡羅出稍衰，滿都魯入河套稱可汗，加思蘭為太師。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Molihai, Berenai, and Wolochu gradually declined; Mandulu entered the Ordos bend and styled himself khan, and Qojasan became grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Molihai, Berenai, and Wolochu gradually waned. Mandulu entered the Ordos bend and proclaimed himself khan, with Qojasan as grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，滿都魯等與孛羅忽並寇韋州。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year Mandulu and others, together with Boluohu, jointly raided Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the ninth year Mandulu and Boluohu jointly raided Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 王越偵知敵盡行，其老弱巢紅鹽池，乃與許寧及游擊周玉率輕騎晝夜疾馳至，分薄其營，前後夾擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Wang Yue learned by reconnaissance that the enemy had all gone out on campaign and that their old and weak had encamped at Red Salt Pool; he then led Xu Ning and Guerrilla Commander Zhou Yu with light cavalry, riding day and night at speed, divided forces to press their camps, and struck from front and rear, inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yue learned through scouts that the enemy had marched out in full strength, leaving their old and weak encamped at Red Salt Pool. He led Xu Ning and Guerrilla Commander Zhou Yu with light cavalry, riding day and night, split his force to press the camps, and struck from both sides, crushing them.

sentences.zh: 復邀擊於韋州。

translations.literal: He again intercepted them in an ambush at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He ambushed them again at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 滿都魯等敗歸，孳畜廬帳蕩盡，妻孥皆喪亡，相顧悲哭去。

translations.literal: Mandulu and the others fled back in defeat; livestock and tents were swept clean, wives and children were all lost, and they went off weeping in despair.
translations.idiomatic: Mandulu and the others fled back in defeat. Their herds and tents were wiped out, wives and children were lost, and they withdrew wailing in despair.

sentences.zh: 自是不復居河套，邊患少弭；

translations.literal: From this time they no longer dwelt in the Ordos bend, and frontier troubles eased somewhat;
translations.idiomatic: From then on they no longer settled in the Ordos bend, and the frontier crisis eased somewhat;

sentences.zh: 間盜邊，弗敢大入，亦數遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: from time to time they still raided the frontier but did not dare enter on a large scale, and they also repeatedly sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: they still raided the frontier from time to time but no longer dared to invade on a large scale, and they also sent tribute envoys to court repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 初，加思蘭以女妻滿都魯，立為可汗。

translations.literal: At first Qojasan gave his daughter in marriage to Mandulu and installed him as khan.
translations.idiomatic: At first Qojasan gave his daughter to Mandulu in marriage and installed him as khan.

sentences.zh: 久之殺孛羅忽，並其眾，益專恣。

translations.literal: After a long while he killed Boluohu and absorbed his followers, growing ever more arbitrary in power.
translations.idiomatic: In time he killed Boluohu and absorbed his followers, growing ever more domineering.

sentences.zh: 滿都魯部脫羅干、亦思馬因謀殺之。

translations.literal: Toragan and Isibayan of Mandulu's division plotted to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Toragan and Isibayan of Mandulu's division plotted to assassinate him.

sentences.zh: 尋滿都魯亦死，諸強酋相繼略盡，邊人稍得息肩。

translations.literal: Before long Mandulu also died, and the powerful chieftains were in succession largely gone; frontier people at last gained a little respite.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Mandulu died as well, and one by one the powerful chieftains were gone; the frontier at last gained a little breathing room.

sentences.zh: 時中官汪直怙恩用事，思以邊功自樹，王越、硃永附之。

translations.literal: At this time the palace eunuch Wang Zhi, relying on imperial favor, wielded power and sought to build his reputation on frontier merit; Wang Yue and Zhu Yong attached themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the palace eunuch Wang Zhi, secure in imperial favor, held power and sought glory on the frontier; Wang Yue and Zhu Yong aligned themselves with him.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，邊將上言，傳聞敵將渡河，遽以永為將軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year frontier generals reported that the enemy were said to be about to cross the river, and Zhu Yong was hastily made general.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixteenth year frontier generals reported that the enemy were about to cross the river, and Zhu Yong was hastily appointed general.

sentences.zh: 直與越督師至邊，未及期，襲敵於威寧海子，大破之，又敗之於大同。

translations.literal: Wang Zhi and Wang Yue directed the army to the frontier and, before the appointed date, surprised the enemy at Weining Lake, inflicting a great defeat, and defeated them again at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi and Wang Yue took command on the frontier and, ahead of schedule, surprised the enemy at Weining Lake and routed them, then defeated them again at Datong.

sentences.zh: 永晉公爵，予世襲，越封威寧伯，直增祿至三百石。

translations.literal: Yong was promoted to duke with a hereditary fief, Yue was enfeoffed as Earl of Weining, and Zhi's stipend was increased to three hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yong was promoted to duke with a hereditary fief, Wang Yue was made Earl of Weining, and Wang Zhi's stipend was raised to three hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詔以越代永總兵。

translations.literal: Before long an edict ordered Yue to replace Yong as supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: Before long an edict appointed Wang Yue to replace Zhu Yong as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 於是亦思馬因等益糾眾盜邊，延及遼塞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Isibayan and others gathered followers in greater numbers to raid the frontier, and the trouble extended to the Liaodong frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Isibayan and his allies gathered larger bands to raid the frontier, and the trouble spread to the Liaodong frontier.

sentences.zh: 秋，敵三萬騎寇大同，連營五十里，殺掠人畜數萬。

translations.literal: In autumn thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong; their camps stretched fifty li, and they killed and plundered tens of thousands of people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong. Their camps stretched fifty li, and they killed and plundered tens of thousands of people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 總兵許寧御之，兵敗，以捷聞。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Xu Ning met them; his army was defeated, yet he reported a victory.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Xu Ning met them, was defeated, and yet reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 敵既得利，長驅入順聖川，散掠渾源、朔諸州。

translations.literal: Having gained their profit, the enemy drove deep into Shunsheng River valley and scattered in raids across Hunyuan, Shuo, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Having taken their spoils, the enemy drove deep into the Shunsheng valley and scattered in raids across Hunyuan, Shuo, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 宣府巡撫秦紘、總兵周玉力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Xuanfu Grand Coordinator Qin Hong and Supreme Commander Zhou Yu fought fiercely and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanfu Grand Coordinator Qin Hong and Supreme Commander Zhou Yu fought hard and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 山西巡撫邊鏞，參將支玉等悉力捍禦，敵去輒復來，迄成化末無寧歲。

translations.literal: Shanxi Grand Coordinator Bian Yong, Assistant Commander Zhi Yu, and others defended with all their strength; the enemy left and returned again, and until the end of the Chenghua reign there was no peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi Grand Coordinator Bian Yong, Assistant Commander Zhi Yu, and others defended with all their strength. The enemy withdrew and returned again, and until the end of the Chenghua reign the frontier knew no quiet year.

sentences.zh: 亦思馬因死，入寇者復稱小王子，又有伯顏猛可王。

translations.literal: When Isibayan died, the raiders again styled themselves under the Little Prince, and there was also Prince Bayan Mengke.
translations.idiomatic: After Isibayan died, the raiders again marched under the name of the Little Prince, and Prince Bayan Mengke also appeared.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年夏，小王子奉書求貢，自稱大元大可汗。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Hongzhi the Little Prince sent a letter requesting tribute, styling himself Great Khan of the Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Hongzhi the Little Prince sent a letter requesting tribute, styling himself Great Khan of the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 朝廷方務優容，許之。

translations.literal: The court was then intent on indulgence and granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then intent on conciliation and granted the request.

sentences.zh: 自是，與伯顏猛可王等屢入貢，漸往來套中，出沒為寇。

translations.literal: From this time on he, together with Prince Bayan Mengke and others, repeatedly came to court with tribute, gradually moving back and forth within the bend, appearing and vanishing as raiders.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he and Prince Bayan Mengke and others sent tribute repeatedly, gradually moving back and forth within the bend, raiding whenever they appeared.

sentences.zh: 八年，北部亦卜剌因王等入套駐牧。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the northern chieftain Yibula and others entered the bend to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the northern chieftain Yibula and others entered the bend to pasture.

sentences.zh: 於是小王子及脫羅干之子火篩相倚日強，為東西諸邊患。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Little Prince and Huosai, son of Toragan, relying on one another, grew daily stronger and became a scourge to the eastern and western frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Little Prince and Huosai, son of Toragan, leaning on each other, grew daily stronger and plagued the eastern and western frontiers.

sentences.zh: 其年，三入遼東，多殺掠。

translations.literal: That year they entered Liaodong three times and killed and plundered heavily.
translations.idiomatic: That year they entered Liaodong three times and killed and plundered heavily.

sentences.zh: 明年，宣、大、延綏諸境俱被殘。

translations.literal: The next year the districts of Xuan, Datong, and Yan-Sui were all ravaged.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan-Sui were all ravaged.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，王越既節制諸邊，乃率輕兵襲敵於賀蘭山後，破之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year, after Wang Yue had been given overall command of the frontiers, he led light troops in a surprise attack on the enemy behind Helan Mountain and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eleventh year, after Wang Yue had been given overall command of the frontiers, he led light troops in a surprise raid behind Helan Mountain and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 明年，敵擁眾入大同、寧夏境，游擊王杲敗績，參將秦恭、副總兵馬升逗遛不進，皆論死。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy gathered a host and entered the territory of Datong and Ningxia; Guerrilla Commander Wang Gao was defeated, Assistant Commander Qin Gong and Vice Supreme Commander Ma Sheng dallied and did not advance, and all were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the enemy gathered a large force and entered Datong and Ningxia. Guerrilla Commander Wang Gao was defeated; Assistant Commander Qin Gong and Vice Supreme Commander Ma Sheng hung back and did not advance, and all were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 時平江伯陳銳為總兵，侍郎許進督師，久無功，被劾去，以保國公硃暉、侍郎史琳代之，太監苗逵監軍。

translations.literal: At this time Pingjiang Earl Chen Rui was supreme commander and Vice Minister Xu Jin directed operations; after long achieving nothing they were impeached and removed, and Defender of the State Zhu Hui and Vice Minister Shi Lin replaced them, with the eunuch Miao Kui supervising the army.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Pingjiang Earl Chen Rui was supreme commander and Vice Minister Xu Jin directed operations. After long months without success they were impeached and removed; Defender of the State Zhu Hui and Vice Minister Shi Lin replaced them, with the eunuch Miao Kui supervising the army.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，小王子復居河套。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year the Little Prince again settled in the Ordos bend.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year the Little Prince again settled in the Ordos bend.

sentences.zh: 明年春，吏部侍郎王鏊上御敵八策：一曰定廟算，二曰重主將，三曰嚴法令，四曰恤邊民，五曰廣招募，六曰用間，七曰分兵，八曰出奇。

translations.literal: The next spring Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Ao submitted eight plans for meeting the enemy: first, fix the court's strategy; second, honor the chief commander; third, enforce laws and orders strictly; fourth, show concern for frontier people; fifth, broaden recruitment; sixth, employ spies; seventh, divide forces; eighth, strike by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Ao submitted eight plans for meeting the enemy: fix the court's strategy; honor the chief commander; enforce discipline strictly; care for frontier people; broaden recruitment; employ spies; divide forces; and strike by surprise.

sentences.zh: 帝命所司知之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the relevant offices to take note.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the relevant offices to take note.

sentences.zh: 時敵以八千騎東駐遼塞下，攻入長勝堡，殺掠殆盡。

translations.literal: At this time the enemy with eight thousand horsemen encamped east on the Liaodong frontier, entered and attacked Changsheng Fortress, and killed and plundered nearly to extinction.
translations.idiomatic: At this time eight thousand enemy horsemen encamped east on the Liaodong frontier, stormed Changsheng Fortress, and killed and plundered almost without mercy.

sentences.zh: 秋，暉等以五路之師夜襲敵於河套，斬首三級，驅孳畜千餘歸，賞甚厚。

translations.literal: In autumn Zhu Hui and the others sent five columns of troops in a night attack on the enemy in the Ordos bend, beheaded three men, drove back more than a thousand head of livestock, and received lavish rewards.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Zhu Hui and the others sent five columns in a night attack on the enemy in the Ordos bend, took three heads, drove off more than a thousand head of livestock, and received lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 小王子以十萬騎從花馬池、鹽池入，散掠固原、寧夏境，三輔震動，戕殺慘酷。

translations.literal: The Little Prince with one hundred thousand horsemen entered by Huamachi and Salt Pool, scattered in raids across Guyuan and Ningxia, and the Three Adjuncts were shaken; the killing was cruel beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince entered with one hundred thousand horsemen through Huamachi and Salt Pool, scattered raids across Guyuan and Ningxia, and shook the Three Adjuncts; the slaughter was savage.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以戶部尚書秦紘總制陝西。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Minister of Revenue Qin Hong was put in overall charge of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Minister of Revenue Qin Hong was put in overall charge of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏，敵入遼東清河堡，至密雲，旋西掠偏頭關。

translations.literal: In summer the enemy entered Qinghe Fortress in Liaodong, reached Miyun, and then turned west to raid Piantou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the enemy entered Qinghe Fortress in Liaodong, reached Miyun, then turned west to raid Piantou Pass.

sentences.zh: 秋，復以五千騎犯遼東長安堡，副總兵劉祥御之，斬首五十一級，敵乃退。

translations.literal: In autumn they again raided Chang'an Fortress in Liaodong with five thousand horsemen; Vice Supreme Commander Liu Xiang met them, beheaded fifty-one men, and the enemy then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn five thousand horsemen raided Chang'an Fortress in Liaodong. Vice Supreme Commander Liu Xiang met them, took fifty-one heads, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年，稍靖。

translations.literal: The next year the frontier grew somewhat quieter.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the frontier grew somewhat quieter.

sentences.zh: 十七年春，敵上書請貢，許之，竟不至；

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventeenth year the enemy sent a letter requesting tribute; this was granted, yet in the end they did not come;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventeenth year the enemy sent a letter requesting tribute. The court granted it, yet they never came;

sentences.zh: 仍入大同殺墩軍，犯宣府及莊浪，守將衛勇、白玉等御卻之。

translations.literal: they still entered Datong and killed beacon soldiers, violated Xuanfu and Zhuanglang, and the defending generals Wei Yong and Bai Yu met and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: instead they entered Datong and killed beacon soldiers, struck Xuanfu and Zhuanglang, and defending generals Wei Yong and Bai Yu drove them back.

sentences.zh: 明年春，敵三萬騎圍靈州，復散掠內地，指揮仇鉞、總兵李祥擊走之。

translations.literal: The next spring thirty thousand enemy horsemen besieged Lingzhou, then scattered in raids across the interior; Commander Qiu Yue and Supreme Commander Li Xiang attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring thirty thousand enemy horsemen besieged Lingzhou, then scattered in raids inland; Commander Qiu Yue and Supreme Commander Li Xiang attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 敵大舉入寇宣府，總兵張俊御之，大敗，裨將張雄、穆榮戰歿。

translations.literal: The enemy launched a major raid into Xuanfu; Supreme Commander Zhang Jun met them and was heavily defeated; Assistant Generals Zhang Xiong and Mu Rong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy launched a major raid into Xuanfu. Supreme Commander Zhang Jun met them and was routed; Assistant Generals Zhang Xiong and Mu Rong were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 武宗嗣位，覆命暉、琳出御。

translations.literal: When the Wuzong Emperor succeeded to the throne, Zhu Hui and Shi Lin were again ordered out to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong succeeded to the throne, Zhu Hui and Shi Lin were again ordered to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 冬，敵入鎮夷所，指揮劉經死之。

translations.literal: In winter the enemy entered Zhenyi Station; Commander Liu Jing died fighting them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the enemy entered Zhenyi Station; Commander Liu Jing was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 復自花馬池毀垣入，掠隆德、靜寧、會寧諸處，關中大擾，以楊一清為總制。

translations.literal: They again broke through the wall at Huamachi, entered, and raided Longde, Jingning, Huining, and other places; Guanzhong was greatly disturbed, and Yang Yiqing was made overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: They broke through the wall at Huamachi again and raided Longde, Jingning, Huining, and neighboring districts. Guanzhong was thrown into turmoil, and Yang Yiqing was appointed overall commander.

sentences.zh: 時正德元年春也。

translations.literal: This was in the spring of the first year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the spring of the first year of Zhengde.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾用事，監軍皆閹人，一清不得職去，文貴、才寬相繼受事。

translations.literal: Liu Jin wielded power; army supervisors were all eunuchs; Yiqing left office unable to perform his duties, and Wen Gui and Cai Kuan succeeded one another in the post.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin held power, army supervisors were all eunuchs, and Yang Yiqing left office unable to exercise his command. Wen Gui and Cai Kuan succeeded one another in the post.

sentences.zh: 二年，敵入寧夏、莊浪及定遼後衛諸境，守將皆逮問。

translations.literal: In the second year the enemy entered Ningxia, Zhuanglang, and the territory of Dingliao Rear Guard; the defending generals were all arrested and questioned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the enemy entered Ningxia, Zhuanglang, and the territory of Dingliao Rear Guard, and the defending generals were all arrested and questioned.

sentences.zh: 四年，敵數寇大同。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the enemy repeatedly raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the enemy repeatedly raided Datong.

sentences.zh: 冬，才寬禦敵於花馬池，中伏死。

translations.literal: In winter Cai Kuan met the enemy at Huamachi and, falling into an ambush, died.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Cai Kuan met the enemy at Huamachi, fell into an ambush, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 總兵馬昂與別部亦孛來戰於木瓜山，勝之，斬三百六十五級，獲馬畜六百餘，軍器二千九百餘。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Ma Ang fought Yibolai of another division at Mugua Mountain, defeated him, beheaded three hundred sixty-five men, and captured more than six hundred horses and livestock and more than twenty-nine hundred pieces of military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Ma Ang fought Yibolai of another division at Mugua Mountain and won, taking three hundred sixty-five heads, more than six hundred horses and livestock, and more than twenty-nine hundred pieces of military equipment.

sentences.zh: 明年，北部亦卜剌與小王子仇殺。

translations.literal: The next year the northern chieftain Yibula and the Little Prince feuded and fought one another.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the northern chieftain Yibula and the Little Prince turned on each other in mutual raids and killings.

sentences.zh: 亦卜剌竄西海，阿爾禿廝與合，逼脅洮西屬番，屢入寇。

translations.literal: Yibula fled to the Western Sea; A'ertusi joined him, coerced the dependent tribes west of Tao, and repeatedly entered to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Yibula fled to the Western Sea, where A'ertusi joined him. Together they intimidated the dependent tribes west of the Tao River and raided again and again.

sentences.zh: 巡撫張翼、總兵王勳不能制，漸深入，邊人苦之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhang Yi and Supreme Commander Wang Xun could not control them; they gradually penetrated deeper, and frontier people suffered bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhang Yi and Supreme Commander Wang Xun could not contain them. The raiders pushed ever deeper inland, and the frontier people suffered terribly.

sentences.zh: 八年夏，擁眾來川，遣使詣翼所，乞邊地駐牧修貢。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighth year they gathered a host and came to the river valley, sent envoys to Yi's headquarters, and begged to pasture on frontier lands and resume tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eighth year they gathered a large force and came to the river valley, sending envoys to Zhang Yi's headquarters to request pasture on frontier lands and a resumption of tribute.

sentences.zh: 翼啖以金帛，令遠徙，亦卜剌遂西掠烏斯藏，據之。

translations.literal: Yi fed them with gold and silk and ordered them to move far away; Yibula then raided west into Ü-Tsang and seized it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi placated them with gold and silk and ordered them to move far away. Yibula then raided west into Tibet and seized the territory.

sentences.zh: 自是洮、岷、松潘無寧歲。

translations.literal: From this time Tao, Min, and Songpan knew no peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Tao, Min, and Songpan knew no year of peace.

sentences.zh: 小王子數入寇，殺掠尤慘。

translations.literal: The Little Prince repeatedly entered to raid, and the killing and plundering were especially cruel.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince raided repeatedly, and the killing and plundering were especially savage.

sentences.zh: 復以五萬騎攻大同，趣朔州，掠馬邑。

translations.literal: He again attacked Datong with fifty thousand horsemen, pressed toward Shuozhou, and raided Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: He again attacked Datong with fifty thousand horsemen, pressed toward Shuozhou, and raided Mayi.

sentences.zh: 帝命咸寧侯仇鉞總兵御之，戰於萬全衛，斬三級，而所失亡十倍，以捷聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Xianning Marquis Qiu Yue as supreme commander to meet them; they fought at Wanquan Guard, beheaded three men, yet losses were ten times the heads taken, and a victory was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Xianning Marquis Qiu Yue supreme commander to meet them. At Wanquan Guard they took three heads, but their losses were ten times greater—and still a victory was reported.

sentences.zh: 明年秋，敵連營數十，寇宣、大塞，而別遣萬騎掠懷安。

translations.literal: The next autumn the enemy encamped in dozens of linked camps, raided the Xuan and Datong frontier, and separately sent ten thousand horsemen to plunder Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: The following autumn the enemy set dozens of linked camps, raided the Xuanfu and Datong frontier, and sent ten thousand horsemen separately to plunder Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 總制叢蘭告急，命太監張永督宣、大、延綏兵，都督白玉為大將，協蘭守禦，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Overall Commander Cong Lan reported an emergency; the emperor ordered the eunuch Zhang Yong to supervise Xuan, Datong, and Yan-Sui troops, with Regional Commander Bai Yu as great general, to assist Lan in defense; the capital was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Overall Commander Cong Lan sent urgent reports. The emperor ordered the eunuch Zhang Yong to supervise troops from Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan-Sui, with Regional Commander Bai Yu as chief general, to assist Lan in the defense. The capital was placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 已，敵逾懷安趣蔚州，至平虜城南，蘭等預置毒飯於田間如農家餉，而設伏以待。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the enemy crossed Huai'an and pressed toward Yuzhou, reaching south of Pinglu City; Lan and the others had beforehand placed poisoned food in the fields like farmers' rations and set an ambush to wait.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the enemy crossed Huai'an and pressed toward Yuzhou, reaching south of Pinglu City. Lan and his officers had planted poisoned food in the fields disguised as farmers' rations and laid an ambush.

sentences.zh: 敵至，中毒，伏猝發，多死者。

translations.literal: When the enemy arrived they were poisoned; the ambush suddenly sprang, and many died.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy arrived they ate the poisoned food; the ambush sprang, and many were killed.

sentences.zh: 其年，小王子部長卜兒孩以內難復奔據西海，出沒寇西北邊。

translations.literal: That year Buritai, a chieftain of the Little Prince's division, because of internal strife again fled to seize the Western Sea and appeared and vanished in raids on the northwestern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That year Buritai, a chieftain of the Little Prince's division, fled to the Western Sea after internal strife and began raiding the northwestern frontier in sudden strikes.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，小王子以七萬騎分道入，與總兵潘浩戰於賈家灣。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year the Little Prince with seventy thousand horsemen entered by separate routes and fought Supreme Commander Pan Hao at Jiajia Bay.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eleventh year the Little Prince entered with seventy thousand horsemen by separate routes and fought Supreme Commander Pan Hao at Jiajia Bay.

sentences.zh: 浩再戰再敗，裨將硃春、王唐死之。

translations.literal: Hao fought twice and was defeated twice; Assistant Generals Zhu Chun and Wang Tang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Hao fought twice and lost both times. Assistant Generals Zhu Chun and Wang Tang were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 張永遇於老營坡，被創走居庸。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong encountered them at Laoying Slope, was wounded, and fled to Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong met them at Laoying Slope, was wounded, and fled toward Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 敵遂犯宣府，凡攻破城堡二十，殺掠人畜數萬。

translations.literal: The enemy then violated Xuanfu; in all they stormed twenty castles and fortresses and killed and plundered tens of thousands of people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy then struck Xuanfu, storming twenty castles and fortresses and killing and plundering tens of thousands of people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 浩奪三官，諸將降罰有差。

translations.literal: Hao was stripped of three ranks; the generals were demoted and punished to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Hao was stripped of three ranks, and the other generals were demoted and punished to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十二年冬，小王子以五萬騎自榆林入寇，圍總兵王勳等於應州。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twelfth year the Little Prince with fifty thousand horsemen entered to raid from Yulin and besieged Supreme Commander Wang Xun and others at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twelfth year the Little Prince entered from Yulin with fifty thousand horsemen and besieged Supreme Commander Wang Xun and his officers at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝幸陽和，親部署，督諸將往援，殊死戰，敵稍卻。

translations.literal: The emperor went in person to Yanghe, deployed forces himself, and directed the generals to go to the rescue; they fought to the death and the enemy withdrew slightly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went in person to Yanghe, took command of the deployment, and directed the generals to the rescue. They fought desperately and the enemy fell back somewhat.

sentences.zh: 明日復來攻，自辰至酉，戰百餘合，敵引而西，追至平虜、朔州，值大風黑霧，晝晦，帝乃還，命宣捷於朝。

translations.literal: The next day they came to attack again; from the hour chen to the hour you they fought more than a hundred engagements; the enemy withdrew westward; pursuit reached Pinglu and Shuozhou; a great wind and black fog made the day dark; the emperor then returned and ordered victory proclaimed at court.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the enemy attacked again. From morning until evening they fought more than a hundred engagements before the enemy withdrew westward. Pursuit reached Pinglu and Shuozhou, but a great wind and black fog blotted out the day, and the emperor turned back and ordered victory proclaimed at court.

sentences.zh: 是後歲犯邊，然不敢大入。

translations.literal: After this they raided the frontier every year, yet did not dare enter on a large scale.
translations.idiomatic: After this they raided the frontier every year but no longer dared to invade on a large scale.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年春，以萬騎寇甘肅。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Jiajing they raided Gansu with ten thousand horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Jiajing they raided Gansu with ten thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 總兵姜奭御之於苦水墩，斬其魁。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Jiang Shi met them at Kushui Dun and beheaded their leader.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Jiang Shi met them at Kushui Dun and killed their leader.

sentences.zh: 明年犯大同及宣府，亦卜剌復駐牧賀蘭山後，數擾邊。

translations.literal: The next year they violated Datong and Xuanfu; Yibula again pastured behind Helan Mountain and repeatedly disturbed the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they struck Datong and Xuanfu. Yibula again pastured behind Helan Mountain and repeatedly harassed the frontier.

sentences.zh: 明年春，小王子兩寇宣府。

translations.literal: The next spring the Little Prince raided Xuanfu twice.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the Little Prince raided Xuanfu twice.

sentences.zh: 參將王經、關山先後戰死。

translations.literal: Assistant Commanders Wang Jing and Guan Shan died in battle in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Commanders Wang Jing and Guan Shan were killed in action, one after the other.

sentences.zh: 秋，以數萬騎犯寧夏塞，尚書王憲以總兵鄭卿等敗之，斬三百餘級。

translations.literal: In autumn they violated the Ningxia frontier with tens of thousands of horsemen; Minister Wang Xian had Supreme Commander Zheng Qing and others defeat them and behead more than three hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn tens of thousands of horsemen struck the Ningxia frontier. Minister Wang Xian had Supreme Commander Zheng Qing and others defeat them and take more than three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 明年春，掠山西。

translations.literal: The next spring they plundered Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they plundered Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏，入大同中路，參將李蓁御卻之。

translations.literal: In summer they entered the middle route of Datong; Assistant Commander Li Zhen met and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they entered Datong by the middle route. Assistant Commander Li Zhen met them and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 冬，復寇大同，指揮趙源戰死。

translations.literal: In winter they again raided Datong; Commander Zhao Yuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they raided Datong again. Commander Zhao Yuan was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，小王子乞通貢，未得命，怒，遂擁十萬騎入寇。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year the Little Prince begged to resume tribute; having received no command, he grew angry and then gathered one hundred thousand horsemen to enter and raid.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year the Little Prince petitioned to resume tribute. When no reply came he grew angry and gathered one hundred thousand horsemen to raid.

sentences.zh: 總制唐龍請許之，帝不聽。

translations.literal: Overall Commander Tang Long requested that this be granted; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Overall Commander Tang Long asked that the request be granted, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 龍連戰，頗有斬獲。

translations.literal: Long fought repeatedly and achieved considerable beheadings and captures.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Long fought repeatedly and won a fair number of heads and captures.

sentences.zh: 時小王子最富強，控弦十餘萬，多畜貨貝，稍厭兵，乃徙幕東方，稱土蠻，分諸部落在西北邊者甚眾。

translations.literal: At this time the Little Prince was richest and strongest; he controlled more than one hundred thousand bowmen, stored much goods and treasure, and gradually grew weary of war; he then moved his camp eastward and styled himself Tumen, while the tribes he divided off on the northwestern frontier were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Little Prince was the richest and strongest of the chieftains. He commanded more than one hundred thousand bowmen and hoarded goods and treasure, but he gradually wearied of war. He moved his camp eastward and styled himself Tumen, while the tribes he left scattered along the northwestern frontier were very numerous.

sentences.zh: 曰吉囊、曰俺答者，於小王子為從父行，據河套，雄黠喜兵，為諸部長，相率躪諸邊。

translations.literal: Those called Gijad and Altan were, to the Little Prince, of his father's younger brothers' generation; they held the Ordos bend, were bold, cunning, and fond of war, and as chieftains of the tribes led one another in trampling the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: Gijad and Altan were the Little Prince's uncles. They held the Ordos bend, were bold, cunning, and warlike, and as chieftains of the tribes they led one another in ravaging the frontiers.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，吉囊擁眾屯套內，將犯延綏，邊臣有備，乃突以五萬騎渡河西，襲亦不剌、卜兒孩兩部，大破之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year Gijad gathered a host and encamped within the bend, intending to violate Yan-Sui; frontier officials were prepared, so he suddenly with fifty thousand horsemen crossed west of the river and surprised the two divisions of Yibolai and Buritai, inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twelfth year Gijad gathered a host and encamped within the bend, intending to strike Yan-Sui. Frontier officials were prepared, so he suddenly crossed west of the river with fifty thousand horsemen and crushed the divisions of Yibolai and Buritai.

sentences.zh: 卜兒孩為莊、寧邊患久，亦郎骨、土魯番諸蕃皆苦之，嘗因屬番帖木哥求貢市，朝廷未之許。

translations.literal: Buritai had long been a scourge on the Zhuanglang and Ningxia frontier; the tribes of Yilanggu, Turfan, and others also suffered from him; they once through the dependent tribesman Timuge begged for tribute markets, but the court did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Buritai had long plagued the Zhuanglang and Ningxia frontier, and the tribes of Yilanggu, Turfan, and others also suffered under him. They once petitioned through the dependent tribesman Timuge for tribute markets, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 至是唐龍以卜兒孩衰敗遠徙，西海獲寧，請無更議款事。

translations.literal: At this Tang Long, because Buritai was defeated and driven far away and the Western Sea gained peace, requested that no further discussion of peaceful overtures be held.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Long now argued that with Buritai defeated and driven far away and the Western Sea at peace, the court should not reopen talks of peaceful overtures.

sentences.zh: 吉囊等既破西海，旋竊入宣府永寧境，大掠而去。

translations.literal: After Gijad and the others had broken the Western Sea forces, they soon stole into the territory of Yongning in Xuanfu and plundered heavily before leaving.
translations.idiomatic: After Gijad and his allies broke the Western Sea forces, they slipped into Yongning in Xuanfu, plundered heavily, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬，犯鎮遠關，總兵王效、副總兵梁震敗之於柳門，又追敗之於蜂窩山，敵溺水死者甚眾。

translations.literal: In winter they violated Zhenyuan Pass; Supreme Commander Wang Xiao and Vice Supreme Commander Liang Zhen defeated them at Liumen and again pursued and defeated them at Fengwo Mountain; many enemy drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they struck Zhenyuan Pass. Supreme Commander Wang Xiao and Vice Supreme Commander Liang Zhen defeated them at Liumen, pursued them to Fengwo Mountain, and defeated them again. Many drowned.

sentences.zh: 明年春，寇大同。

translations.literal: The next spring they raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they raided Datong.

sentences.zh: 秋，復由花馬池入犯，梁震及總兵劉文拒卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn they again entered to raid by Huamachi; Liang Zhen and Supreme Commander Liu Wen met and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they entered again through Huamachi. Liang Zhen and Supreme Commander Liu Wen met them and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 十五年夏，吉囊以十萬眾屯賀蘭山，分兵寇涼州，副總兵王輔御之，斬五十七級。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifteenth year Gijad with one hundred thousand men encamped at Helan Mountain, divided troops to raid Liangzhou, and Vice Supreme Commander Wang Fu met them and beheaded fifty-seven men.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifteenth year Gijad encamped at Helan Mountain with one hundred thousand men, sent detachments to raid Liangzhou, and Vice Supreme Commander Wang Fu met them and took fifty-seven heads.

sentences.zh: 又入莊浪境，總兵姜奭遇之於分水嶺，三戰三勝之。

translations.literal: They again entered Zhuanglang territory; Supreme Commander Jiang Shi encountered them at Fenshui Ridge, fought three times, and won three times.
translations.idiomatic: They entered Zhuanglang again. Supreme Commander Jiang Shi met them at Fenshui Ridge, fought three engagements, and won all three.

sentences.zh: 又入延綏及寧夏邊。

translations.literal: They again entered the Yan-Sui and Ningxia frontier.
translations.idiomatic: They struck the Yan-Sui and Ningxia frontier again.

sentences.zh: 冬，復犯大同，入掠宣大塞，總制侍郎劉天和、總督尚書楊守禮及巡撫都御史楚書悉力御之。

translations.literal: In winter they again violated Datong, entered and plundered the Xuan and Datong frontier; Overall Commander Vice Minister Liu Tianhe, Governor Minister Yang Shouli, and Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Chu Shu all exerted their strength to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they struck Datong again and plundered the Xuanfu and Datong frontier. Overall Commander Vice Minister Liu Tianhe, Governor Minister Yang Shouli, and Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Chu Shu mustered all their strength to meet them.

sentences.zh: 十九年秋，書以總兵白爵等三敗敵於萬全右衛境，斬百餘級。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the nineteenth year Chu, with Supreme Commander Bai Jue and others, three times defeated the enemy within the territory of Wanquan Right Guard and beheaded more than one hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the nineteenth year Chu Shu, with Supreme Commander Bai Jue and others, defeated the enemy three times within Wanquan Right Guard and took more than one hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 天和以總兵周尚文大破敵於黑水苑，斬吉囊子小十王。

translations.literal: Tianhe with Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen inflicted a great defeat on the enemy at Heishui Park and beheaded Gijad's son Xiaoshiwang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tianhe and Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen crushed the enemy at Heishui Park and killed Gijad's son Xiaoshiwang.

sentences.zh: 明年春，守禮以總兵李義禦敵於鎮朔堡，以總兵楊信禦敵於甘肅，皆勝之。

translations.literal: The next spring Shouli had Supreme Commander Li Yi meet the enemy at Zhenshuo Fortress and Supreme Commander Yang Xin meet the enemy at Gansu; both were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Yang Shouli had Supreme Commander Li Yi meet the enemy at Zhenshuo Fortress and Supreme Commander Yang Xin meet them in Gansu; both won.

sentences.zh: 秋，俺答及其屬阿不孩遣使石天爵款大同塞，巡撫史道以聞，詔卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn Altan and his follower Abunai sent the envoy Shi Tianjue to offer peaceful overtures at the Datong frontier; Grand Coordinator Shi Dao reported this, and an edict rejected them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Altan and his follower Abunai sent the envoy Shi Tianjue to offer peaceful overtures at the Datong frontier. Grand Coordinator Shi Dao reported this, and the court rejected them.

sentences.zh: 以尚書樊繼祖督宣大兵，懸賞格購俺答、阿不孩首。

translations.literal: Minister Fan Jizu was put in charge of Xuan and Datong troops, and a bounty was posted for the heads of Altan and Abunai.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Fan Jizu was put in charge of Xuanfu and Datong troops, and a bounty was posted for the heads of Altan and Abunai.

sentences.zh: 遂大舉內犯，俺答下石嶺關，趣太原。

translations.literal: Thereupon they launched a major invasion inland; Altan descended Shiling Pass and pressed toward Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they launched a major invasion inland. Altan descended Shiling Pass and pressed toward Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 吉囊田平虜衛入掠平定、壽陽諸處。

translations.literal: Gijad entered via Pinglu Guard to plunder Pingding, Shouyang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Gijad entered through Pinglu Guard and plundered Pingding, Shouyang, and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 總兵丁璋、游擊周宇戰死，諸將多獲罪，繼祖獨蒙賞。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Ding Zhang and Guerrilla Commander Zhou Yu died in battle; many generals were punished, yet Jizu alone received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Ding Zhang and Guerrilla Commander Zhou Yu were killed in action. Many generals were punished, yet Fan Jizu alone was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二十一年夏，敵復遣天爵求貢。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-first year the enemy again sent Tianjue to request tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-first year the enemy again sent Tianjue to request tribute.

sentences.zh: 大同巡撫龍大有誘縛之，上之朝，詭言用計擒獲。

translations.literal: Datong Grand Coordinator Long Dayou lured and bound him, sent him up to court, and falsely claimed he had been captured by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Grand Coordinator Long Dayou lured and bound him, sent him to court, and falsely claimed a stratagem had captured him.

sentences.zh: 帝悅，擢大有兵部侍郎，邊臣升賞者數十人，磔天爵於市。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased, promoted Dayou to Vice Minister of War, rewarded several tens of frontier officials with promotions, and dismembered Tianjue in the market.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased. He promoted Long Dayou to Vice Minister of War, rewarded dozens of frontier officials, and had Tianjue dismembered in the market.

sentences.zh: 敵怒，入寇，掠朔州，抵廣武，由太原南下，沁、汾、襄垣、長子皆被殘；

translations.literal: The enemy grew angry, entered to raid, plundered Shuozhou, reached Guangwu, and from Taiyuan went south; Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi were all ravaged;
translations.idiomatic: The enemy grew furious and raided again. They plundered Shuozhou, reached Guangwu, and swept south from Taiyuan. Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi were all ravaged;

sentences.zh: 復從忻、崞、代而北，屯祁縣。

translations.literal: they again went north from Xin, Guo, and Dai and encamped at Qixian.
translations.idiomatic: then they turned north through Xin, Guo, and Dai and encamped at Qixian.

sentences.zh: 參將張世忠力戰，敵圍之數重。

translations.literal: Assistant Commander Zhang Shizhong fought fiercely; the enemy surrounded him in many rings.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Commander Zhang Shizhong fought fiercely, but the enemy surrounded him in layer after layer.

sentences.zh: 自巳至申，所殺傷相當。

translations.literal: From the hour si to the hour shen the killing and wounding on both sides were about equal.
translations.idiomatic: From mid-morning until late afternoon the killing and wounding on both sides were roughly equal.

sentences.zh: 已而世忠矢盡見殺，百戶張宣、張臣俱死，敵遂從雁門故道去。

translations.literal: Before long Shizhong's arrows were exhausted and he was killed; Company Commanders Zhang Xuan and Zhang Chen both died; the enemy then departed by the old road of Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhang Shizhong ran out of arrows and was killed. Company Commanders Zhang Xuan and Zhang Chen also died. The enemy then withdrew by the old Yanmen road.

sentences.zh: 秋，復入朔州。

translations.literal: In autumn they again entered Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they entered Shuozhou again.

sentences.zh: 吉囊死，諸子狼台吉等散處河西，勢既分，俺答獨盛，歲數擾延綏諸邊。

translations.literal: Gijad died; his sons Langtaiji and others scattered in Hexi; their power was already divided, and Altan alone flourished, yearly repeatedly disturbing the Yan-Sui frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Gijad died. His sons Langtaiji and others scattered across Hexi, and their power was divided. Altan alone flourished and harassed the Yan-Sui frontier year after year.

sentences.zh: 二十三年冬，小王子自萬全右衛入，至蔚州及完縣。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twenty-third year the Little Prince entered from Wanquan Right Guard and reached Yuzhou and Wanxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twenty-third year the Little Prince entered from Wanquan Right Guard and reached Yuzhou and Wanxian.

sentences.zh: 京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: The capital was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 二十四年秋，俺答犯延綏及大同，總兵張達拒卻之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fourth year Altan violated Yan-Sui and Datong; Supreme Commander Zhang Da met and drove him back.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-fourth year Altan struck Yan-Sui and Datong. Supreme Commander Zhang Da met him and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 又犯鵓鴿峪，參將張鳳、指揮劉欽、千戶李瓚、生員王邦直等皆戰死。

translations.literal: He again violated Boguge Valley; Assistant Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, Company Commander Li Zan, student Wang Bangzhi, and others all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Boguge Valley again. Assistant Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, Company Commander Li Zan, student Wang Bangzhi, and others were all killed in action.

sentences.zh: 會總督侍郎翁萬達、總兵周尚文嚴兵備陽和，敵引去。

translations.literal: It happened that Governor Vice Minister Weng Wanda and Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen strictly prepared troops at Yanghe, and the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Vice Minister Weng Wanda and Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen had strictly prepared the defenses at Yanghe, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，俺答覆遣使詣大同塞，求貢，邊卒殺之。

translations.literal: The next summer Altan again sent envoys to the Datong frontier requesting tribute, and frontier soldiers killed them.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer Altan again sent envoys to the Datong frontier to request tribute, and frontier soldiers killed them.

sentences.zh: 秋，復來請，萬達再疏以聞，帝不許。

translations.literal: In autumn they came to request again; Wanda memorialized again to report this, and the emperor did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they petitioned again. Weng Wanda memorialized once more, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 敵以十萬騎西入保安，掠慶陽、環縣而東，以萬騎寇錦、義。

translations.literal: The enemy with one hundred thousand horsemen entered Bao'an from the west, plundered Qingyang and Huanxian and turned east, and with ten thousand horsemen raided Jin and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy entered Bao'an from the west with one hundred thousand horsemen, plundered Qingyang and Huanxian, turned east, and sent ten thousand horsemen to raid Jin and Yi.

sentences.zh: 總督三邊侍郎曾銑率參將李珍等直搗敵巢於馬梁山後，斬百餘級，敵始退。

translations.literal: Governor of the Three Frontiers Vice Minister Zeng Xuan led Assistant Commander Li Zhen and others straight to strike the enemy's nest behind Mabliang Mountain, beheaded more than one hundred men, and the enemy then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of the Three Frontiers Vice Minister Zeng Xuan led Assistant Commander Li Zhen and others in a direct strike on the enemy camp behind Mabliang Mountain, took more than one hundred heads, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 銑議復河套，大學士夏言主之。

translations.literal: Xuan proposed recovering the Ordos bend; Grand Secretary Xia Yan supported it.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Xuan proposed recovering the Ordos bend, and Grand Secretary Xia Yan supported the plan.

sentences.zh: 帝方向用言，令銑圖上方略，以便宜從事。

translations.literal: The emperor was then inclined to employ Yan and ordered Xuan to draft strategy above and act as circumstances permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then inclined to favor Xia Yan and ordered Zeng Xuan to draft strategy and act as circumstances permitted.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，萬達復言：「敵自冬涉春屢求貢，詞恭，似宜許。

translations.literal: The next summer Wanda again said: "Since winter through spring the enemy has repeatedly requested tribute; their words are respectful, and it seems fitting to grant it.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer Weng Wanda memorialized again: "Since winter through spring the enemy has repeatedly requested tribute. Their words are respectful, and it seems fitting to grant it.

sentences.zh: 」不聽，責萬達罔瀆。

translations.literal: " The emperor would not listen and rebuked Wanda for deceit and disrespect.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor refused and rebuked Weng Wanda for deceit and disrespect.

sentences.zh: 銑鳩兵繕塞，輒破敵。

translations.literal: Xuan gathered troops and repaired the frontier defenses, and whenever he fought he broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Xuan gathered troops and repaired the frontier defenses, and whenever he fought he defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 既而帝意中變，言與銑竟得罪，斬西市。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor's mind changed midway; Yan and Xuan in the end were punished and executed at the Western Market.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor changed his mind. Xia Yan and Zeng Xuan were punished in the end and executed at the Western Market.

sentences.zh: 敵益蓄忿思逞，廷臣不敢言復套事矣。

translations.literal: The enemy grew ever more resentful and eager to show their strength; court ministers no longer dared speak of recovering the bend.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy grew ever more resentful and eager to strike. Court ministers no longer dared speak of recovering the bend.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春，犯宣府滴水崖。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-eighth year they violated Dingshui Cliff in Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-eighth year they struck Dingshui Cliff in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 把總指揮江瀚、董暘戰死，全軍覆，遂犯永寧、大同。

translations.literal: Detachment Commander Jiang Han and Dong Yang died in battle; the whole army was destroyed; they then violated Yongning and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Detachment Commander Jiang Han and Dong Yang were killed in action and the whole detachment was wiped out. The enemy then struck Yongning and Datong.

sentences.zh: 總兵周尚文御之於曹家莊，大敗之，斬其魁。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen met them at Caojiazhuang, inflicted a great defeat, and beheaded their leader.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen met them at Caojiazhuang, routed them, and killed their leader.

sentences.zh: 會萬達自懷來赴援，宣府總兵趙國忠聞警，亦率千騎追擊，復連敗之。

translations.literal: It happened that Wanda came from Huailai to reinforce; Xuanfu Supreme Commander Zhao Guozhong, hearing the alarm, also led one thousand horsemen in pursuit and again inflicted successive defeats.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Wanda came from Huailai to reinforce, and Xuanfu Supreme Commander Zhao Guozhong, hearing the alarm, also led one thousand horsemen in pursuit. Together they inflicted successive defeats.

sentences.zh: 是歲，犯西塞者五。

translations.literal: That year the western frontier was violated five times.
translations.idiomatic: That year the western frontier was struck five times.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春，俺答移駐威寧海子。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-ninth year Altan moved his camp to Weining Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-ninth year Altan moved his camp to Weining Lake.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯大同，總兵張達、林椿死之。

translations.literal: In summer he violated Datong; Supreme Commander Zhang Da and Lin Chun died fighting them.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he struck Datong. Supreme Commander Zhang Da and Lin Chun were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 敵引去，傳箭諸部大舉。

translations.literal: The enemy withdrew and passed arrows among the tribes for a general mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy withdrew and passed the war arrow among the tribes to summon a general mobilization.

sentences.zh: 秋，循潮河川南下至古北口，都御史王汝孝率薊鎮兵御之。

translations.literal: In autumn they followed the Chaohu River valley south to Gubeikou; Censor-in-Chief Wang Ruxiao led Jizhou troops to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they followed the Chaohu River valley south to Gubeikou. Censor-in-Chief Wang Ruxiao led Jizhou troops to meet them.

sentences.zh: 敵陽引滿內向，而別遣精騎從間道潰牆入。

translations.literal: The enemy feigned drawing their bows inward while separately sending picked horsemen by a hidden path to break through the wall and enter.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy feigned a frontal advance while sending picked horsemen by a hidden path to break through the wall.

sentences.zh: 汝孝兵潰，遂大掠懷柔，圍順義，抵通州，分兵四掠，焚湖渠馬房。

translations.literal: Ruxiao's army collapsed; they then plundered Huairou heavily, besieged Shunyi, reached Tongzhou, divided troops in four directions to plunder, and burned the lake-channel horse farms.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ruxiao's army collapsed. The enemy plundered Huairou heavily, besieged Shunyi, reached Tongzhou, divided into four columns to raid, and burned the lake-channel horse farms.

sentences.zh: 畿甸大震。

translations.literal: The capital region was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region was thrown into shock.

sentences.zh: 敵大眾犯京師，大同總兵咸寧侯仇鸞、巡撫保定都御史楊守謙等，各以勤王兵至。

translations.literal: The enemy's great host violated the capital; Datong Supreme Commander Xianning Marquis Qiu Luan, Baoding Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Yang Shouqian, and others each arrived with armies to relieve the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy's great host struck at the capital. Datong Supreme Commander Xianning Marquis Qiu Luan, Baoding Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Yang Shouqian, and others each arrived with relief armies.

sentences.zh: 帝拜鸞為大將軍，使護諸軍。

translations.literal: The emperor invested Luan as great general and had him protect the armies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor invested Qiu Luan as great general and put him in command of the relief armies.

sentences.zh: 鸞與守謙皆軿懦不敢戰，兵部尚書丁汝夔忄匡擾不知所為，閉門守。

translations.literal: Luan and Shouqian were both cowardly and dared not fight; Minister of War Ding Ruao was panicked and at a loss, and closed the gates to hold defense.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan and Yang Shouqian were both cowardly and dared not fight. Minister of War Ding Ruao was panicked and at a loss, and simply shut the gates.

sentences.zh: 敵焚掠三日夜，引去。

translations.literal: The enemy burned and plundered for three days and nights and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy burned and plundered for three days and nights, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 帝誅汝夔及守謙。

translations.literal: The emperor executed Ruao and Shouqian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor executed Ding Ruao and Yang Shouqian.

sentences.zh: 敵將出白羊口，鸞尾之。

translations.literal: When the enemy were about to exit Baiyang Pass, Luan followed their rear.
translations.idiomatic: As the enemy were about to exit Baiyang Pass, Qiu Luan followed in their rear.

sentences.zh: 敵猝東返，鸞出不意，兵潰，死傷千餘人。

translations.literal: The enemy suddenly turned back east; Luan, caught unprepared, had his army collapse; more than a thousand were killed or wounded.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy suddenly wheeled east. Caught unprepared, Qiu Luan's army collapsed, and more than a thousand were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 敵乃徐由古北口出塞。

translations.literal: The enemy then slowly withdrew through Gubeikou and left the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy then slowly withdrew through Gubeikou and crossed back beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 諸將收斬遺屍，得八十餘級，以捷聞。

translations.literal: The generals gathered and executed the remaining corpses, obtaining more than eighty heads, and reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: The generals collected the enemy dead and took more than eighty heads, then reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 方俺答薄都城時，縱所擄馬房內官楊增持書入城求貢。

translations.literal: Just as Altan Khan was pressing close to the capital, he released the eunuch Yang Zeng of the horse farms whom they had captured, sending him into the city with a letter seeking tribute.
translations.idiomatic: While Altan Khan was pressing close to the capital, he released the captured horse-farm eunuch Yang Zeng and sent him into the city with a letter requesting tribute.

sentences.zh: 輔臣徐階等謂當以計款之，諭令退屯塞外，因邊臣以請。

translations.literal: Chief ministers Xu Jie and others said they should use stratagem to treat him kindly, instruct him to withdraw and encamp beyond the frontier, and have border officials submit the request.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers Xu Jie and others argued that he should be handled with diplomatic delay: Altan was to be told to withdraw and encamp beyond the frontier, and border officials would submit the tribute request on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 俺答歸，遣子脫脫陳款。

translations.literal: Altan returned and sent his son Toto to present overtures of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Altan withdrew and sent his son Toto to present overtures of peace.

sentences.zh: 時鸞方用事，乃議開馬市以中敵。

translations.literal: At that time Qiu Luan was in power, and they debated opening a horse market to win over the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan was then in power, and the court debated opening a horse market to win the enemy over.

sentences.zh: 兵部郎中楊繼盛上疏爭之，不得。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of War Yang Jisheng submitted a memorial objecting, but was overruled.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jisheng, supervising secretary in the Ministry of War, submitted a memorial in protest, but his objection was rejected.

sentences.zh: 明年春，以侍郎史道蒞其事，給白金十萬，開市大同，次及延、寧。

translations.literal: The next spring, Vice Minister Shi Dao was appointed to oversee the matter; one hundred thousand taels of silver were granted, and the market was opened at Datong, extending next to Yan and Ning.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Vice Minister Shi Dao was put in charge of the arrangement. One hundred thousand taels of silver were allocated, and markets were opened at Datong and then extended to Yan'an and Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 叛人蕭芹、呂明鎮者，故以罪亡入敵，挾白蓮邪教，與其黨趙全、丘富、周原、喬源諸人導俺答為患。

translations.literal: The renegades Xiao Qin and Lü Mingzhen had formerly fled into the enemy's territory as criminals; they carried the White Lotus heresy, and with their associates Zhao Quan, Qiu Fu, Zhou Yuan, Qiao Yuan, and others guided Altan in causing trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The renegades Xiao Qin and Lü Mingzhen had fled into Tartar territory as fugitives from justice. Espousing the White Lotus heresy, they and their followers—Zhao Quan, Qiu Fu, Zhou Yuan, Qiao Yuan, and others—guided Altan in his raids.

sentences.zh: 俺答市畢，旋入掠。

translations.literal: When Altan finished trading, he immediately entered to raid.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as Altan finished trading, he turned around and raided again.

sentences.zh: 邊臣責之，以芹等為詞。

translations.literal: Border officials rebuked him, and he used Qin and the others as his excuse.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials rebuked him, but he pleaded that Qin and the others were to blame.

sentences.zh: 芹詭有術，能墮城。

translations.literal: Qin falsely claimed to have a technique that could cause cities to fall.
translations.idiomatic: Qin falsely claimed to possess a technique that could bring cities down.

sentences.zh: 敵試之不驗，遂縛芹及明鎮，而全、富等竟匿不出。

translations.literal: The enemy tested it and it did not work; they then bound Qin and Mingzhen, while Quan, Fu, and the others in the end hid and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: The Tartars tested the claim and found it false. They bound Qin and Mingzhen, while Quan, Fu, and the others remained in hiding and refused to surrender.

sentences.zh: 俺答覆請以牛馬易粟豆，求職役誥敕，又潛約河西諸部內犯，墮諸邊垣。

translations.literal: Altan again requested to trade cattle and horses for grain and beans, sought patent letters of appointment for official posts, and secretly arranged with the Hexi tribes to invade inward and breach the border walls.
translations.idiomatic: Altan again asked to trade cattle and horses for grain and beans, sought patent letters appointing his men to official posts, and secretly arranged with the Hexi tribes to invade and breach the border walls.

sentences.zh: 帝惡之，詔罷馬市，召道還。

translations.literal: The emperor hated this, issued an edict abolishing the horse market, and recalled Dao.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was disgusted and issued an edict abolishing the horse market and recalling Shi Dao.

sentences.zh: 自是，敵日寇掠西邊，邊人大困。

translations.literal: From then on, the enemy raided the western frontier day by day, and the border people were greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the enemy raided the western frontier almost daily, and the border population was plunged into misery.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，敵二千騎寇大同，指揮王恭御之於平川墩，戰死。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-first year, two thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong; Commander Wang Gong met them at Pingchuan Fort and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-first year, two thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong. Commander Wang Gong met them at Pingchuan Fort and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 夏，東入遼塞，圍百戶常祿，指揮姚大謨、劉棟、劉啟基等於三道氵冓，四人皆戰沒。

translations.literal: In summer they entered the Liaodong frontier in the east, besieged Centurion Chang Lu, and together with Commanders Yao Damo, Liu Dong, and Liu Qiji and others at Sandao Gou—all four died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they entered the Liaodong frontier from the east and besieged Centurion Chang Lu along with Commanders Yao Damo, Liu Dong, and Liu Qiji at Sandao Gou. All four died fighting.

sentences.zh: 備御指揮王相赴援，大戰於寺兒山，殺傷相當，敵捨去。

translations.literal: Defense Commander Wang Xiang went to relieve them; a great battle was fought at Si'er Mountain, casualties were roughly equal, and the enemy broke off and left.
translations.idiomatic: Defense Commander Wang Xiang marched to relieve them and fought a great battle at Si'er Mountain. Casualties were roughly equal on both sides, and the enemy broke off and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 千戶葉廷瑞率百人助相。

translations.literal: Centurion Ye Tingrui led a hundred men to assist Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Centurion Ye Tingrui led a hundred men to reinforce Wang Xiang.

sentences.zh: 明日，相裹創復邀敵於蠟黎山，殊死鬥，矢竭，遂與麾下將士三百人皆死之。

translations.literal: The next day Xiang, binding his wounds, again engaged the enemy at Wali Mountain in a fight to the death; when arrows were exhausted, he and the three hundred officers and men under his command all died.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Wang Xiang, binding his wounds, again engaged the enemy at Wali Mountain in a fight to the death. When his arrows were spent, he and all three hundred officers and men under his command perished.

sentences.zh: 廷瑞被創死復甦，敵亦引退。

translations.literal: Tingrui was wounded to death but revived; the enemy also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Tingrui was wounded so severely that he appeared dead, then revived; the enemy also withdrew.

sentences.zh: 其年，凡四犯大同，三犯遼陽，一犯寧夏。

translations.literal: That year, in all they raided Datong four times, Liaoyang three times, and Ningxia once.
translations.idiomatic: That year they raided Datong four times, Liaoyang three times, and Ningxia once.

sentences.zh: 明年春，犯宣府及延綏。

translations.literal: The next spring they raided Xuanfu and Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they raided Xuanfu and Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯甘肅及大同。

translations.literal: In summer they raided Gansu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they raided Gansu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 守將御之輒敗。

translations.literal: The defending generals met them and were repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever defending generals met them, they were defeated.

sentences.zh: 秋，俺答覆大舉入寇，下渾源、靈丘、廣昌，急攻插箭、浮圖等峪。

translations.literal: In autumn Altan again launched a major invasion, descended on Hunyuan, Lingqiu, and Guangchang, and urgently attacked Chajian, Futu, and other passes.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn Altan launched another major invasion, descending on Hunyuan, Lingqiu, and Guangchang and pressing hard against the passes at Chajian, Futu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 固原游擊陳鳳、寧夏游擊硃玉率兵赴援，大戰卻之。

translations.literal: Mobile Corps Commanders Chen Feng of Guyuan and Zhu Yu of Ningxia led troops to relieve them and repelled the enemy in a great battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mobile corps commanders Chen Feng of Guyuan and Zhu Yu of Ningxia led relief troops and repelled the enemy in a great battle.

sentences.zh: 敵分兵東犯蔚，西掠代、繁畤。

translations.literal: The enemy divided their forces: east to raid Yu, west to plunder Dai and Fanzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy divided their forces, raiding Yu in the east and plundering Dai and Fanzhi in the west.

sentences.zh: 已，駐鹿阝、延二十日，延慶諸城屠掠幾遍，乃移營中部，以瞰涇、原，會久雨乃去。

translations.literal: Afterward they encamped at Luye and Yan for twenty days, slaughtering and plundering virtually every town of Yanqing; they then moved camp to the central regions to overlook Jing and Yuan, and left only when prolonged rains set in.
translations.idiomatic: They then encamped at Luye and Yan for twenty days, slaughtering and plundering nearly every town in Yanqing. Afterward they shifted camp to the central regions to threaten Jingzhou and Guyuan, and withdrew only when heavy rains set in.

sentences.zh: 時小王子亦乘隙為寇，犯宣府赤城。

translations.literal: At this time the Lesser Prince also seized an opening to raid, violating Chicheng in Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the Lesser Prince seized the opening to raid as well, striking Chicheng in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 未幾，俺答覆以萬騎入大同，縱掠至八角堡。

translations.literal: Before long Altan again entered Datong with ten thousand horsemen, plundering freely as far as Bajiao Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Altan again entered Datong with ten thousand horsemen and plundered freely as far as Bajiao Fort.

sentences.zh: 巡撫趙時春御之，遇敵於大蟲嶺，總兵李淶戰死，軍覆，時春僅以身免。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun met them, encountered the enemy at Dachong Ridge; Supreme Commander Li Cai died in battle, the army was annihilated, and Shichun barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun went to meet them and encountered the enemy at Dachong Ridge. Supreme Commander Li Cai was killed in battle, the army was destroyed, and Zhao Shichun barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 三十三年春，入宣府柴溝堡。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-third year they entered Chaigou Fort in Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-third year they entered Chaigou Fort in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 夏，復犯寧夏，大同總兵岳懋中伏死。

translations.literal: In summer they again raided Ningxia; Datong Supreme Commander Yue Maozhong was killed in an ambush.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they raided Ningxia again. Datong supreme commander Yue Maozhong was killed in an ambush.

sentences.zh: 秋，攻薊鎮牆，百道並進。

translations.literal: In autumn they attacked the walls of Jizhou, advancing by a hundred routes at once.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn they attacked the walls of Jizhou, advancing along a hundred routes at once.

sentences.zh: 警報日數十至，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Alarm reports arrived by the dozens each day, and the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Alarm reports arrived by the dozens each day, and the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 總督楊博悉力拒守，募死士夜砍其營，敵驚擾乃遁。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang Bo exerted all his strength in defense, recruited dare-to-die men to cut into the enemy camps by night, and the enemy, startled and thrown into disorder, fled.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang Bo defended with all his strength, recruited dare-to-die men to strike the enemy camps by night, and the startled enemy broke off in disorder and fled.

sentences.zh: 明年數犯宣、薊，參將趙傾葵、李光啟、丁碧先後戰死。

translations.literal: The next year they raided Xuan and Ji several times; Regimental Commanders Zhao Qingkui, Li Guangqi, and Ding Bi died in battle in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they raided Xuanfu and Jizhou several times. Regimental commanders Zhao Qingkui, Li Guangqi, and Ding Bi were killed in battle one after another.

sentences.zh: 朝廷再下賞格，購俺答首，賜萬金，爵伯；

translations.literal: The court again issued reward notices, offering a price for Altan's head—ten thousand in gold and a marquisate.
translations.idiomatic: The court again posted reward notices offering ten thousand in gold and a marquisate for Altan Khan's head.

sentences.zh: 獲丘富、周原者三百金，授三品武階。

translations.literal: For capturing Qiu Fu and Zhou Yuan, three hundred in gold and appointment to the third military rank.
translations.idiomatic: For capturing Qiu Fu and Zhou Yuan, the reward was three hundred taels of gold and appointment to the third military rank.

sentences.zh: 時富等在敵，招集亡命，居豐州，築城自衛，構宮殿，墾水田，號曰板升。

translations.literal: At that time Fu and the others were with the enemy; they gathered fugitives, dwelt at Fengzhou, built a walled settlement for self-defense, constructed palaces, opened irrigated fields, and called the place Bansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Fu and the others were then living among the Tartars. They gathered fugitives, settled at Fengzhou, built walled towns for self-defense, erected palaces, opened irrigated fields, and called the settlements bansheng.

sentences.zh: 板升，華言屋也。

translations.literal: Bansheng—in Chinese speech, a house.
translations.idiomatic: Bansheng meant "house" in Chinese.

sentences.zh: 趙全教敵，益習攻戰事。

translations.literal: Zhao Quan instructed the enemy and they grew increasingly skilled in siege and battle.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Quan instructed the Tartars, and they grew increasingly adept at siege and battle.

sentences.zh: 俺答愛之甚，每入寇必置酒全所問計。

translations.literal: Altan loved him greatly; whenever he launched a raid he would hold wine at Quan's place and ask his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Altan favored him greatly. Before every raid he would feast at Zhao Quan's home and ask his advice.

sentences.zh: 三十五年夏，敵三萬騎犯宣府。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirty-fifth year, thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirty-fifth year, thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 游擊張紘迎戰，敗死。

translations.literal: Mobile Corps Commander Zhang Hong met them in battle and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Mobile corps commander Zhang Hong met them in battle and was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 冬，掠大同邊，繼掠陝西環、慶諸處，守將孫朝、袁正等卻之。

translations.literal: In winter they plundered the Datong frontier, then plundered Huan and Qing in Shaanxi and other places; defending generals Sun Chao and Yuan Zheng repelled them.
