translations.idiomatic: In winter they plundered the Datong frontier and then raided Huanzhou, Qingyang, and other parts of Shaanxi. Defending generals Sun Chao and Yuan Zheng drove them back.

sentences.zh: 其年，土蠻再犯遼東。

translations.literal: That year Tumen again raided Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tumen Khan again raided Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 明年，敵以二萬騎分掠大同邊，殺守備唐天祿、把總汪淵。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy divided twenty thousand horsemen to plunder the Datong frontier, killing Defense Commander Tang Tianlu and Company Commander Wang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the enemy sent twenty thousand horsemen in separate columns to plunder the Datong frontier, killing Defense Commander Tang Tianlu and Company Commander Wang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 俺答弟老把都復擁眾數萬入河流口，犯永平及遷安，副總兵蔣承勳力戰死。

translations.literal: Altan's younger brother La Batu again led a host of tens of thousands through Heliukou, violating Yongping and Qian'an; Vice Supreme Commander Jiang Chengxun fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: Altan's younger brother La Batu again led tens of thousands through Heliukou and struck Yongping and Qian'an. Vice supreme commander Jiang Chengxun fought fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 夏，突犯宣府馬尾梁，參將祁勉戰死。

translations.literal: In summer they suddenly raided Maweiliang in Xuanfu; Regimental Commander Qi Mian died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they suddenly struck Maweiliang in Xuanfu. Regimental commander Qi Mian was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 秋，復入大同右衛境，攻毀七十餘堡，所殺擄甚眾。

translations.literal: In autumn they again entered the territory of Datong Right Guard, attacked and destroyed more than seventy forts, and killed and captured a great many people.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn they again entered Datong Right Guard territory, attacked and destroyed more than seventy forts, and killed or captured a great many people.

sentences.zh: 冬，俺答子辛愛有妾曰桃松寨，私部目收令哥，懼誅來降。

translations.literal: In winter Altan's son Xing'ai had a concubine named Taosongzhai who privately took the tribal officer Shoulinge; fearing execution, she came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Altan's son Xing'ai had a concubine named Taosongzhai who had secretly taken up with the tribal officer Shoulinge. Fearing punishment, she defected to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 總督楊順自詡為奇功，致之闕下。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang Shun boasted that this was a singular achievement and had her brought to the imperial court.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang Shun touted this as a singular achievement and had her brought to the imperial court.

sentences.zh: 辛愛來索不得，乃縱掠大同諸墩堡，圍右衛數匝。

translations.literal: Xing'ai came to demand her back but could not obtain her; he then plundered the forts and beacon towers of Datong and surrounded Right Guard many times over.
translations.idiomatic: Xing'ai came to demand her return but was refused. He then plundered Datong's forts and beacon towers and surrounded Right Guard many times over.

sentences.zh: 順懼，乃詭言敵願易我以趙全、丘富。

translations.literal: Shun was afraid and falsely claimed the enemy wished to exchange her for Zhao Quan and Qiu Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shun, afraid, falsely claimed the enemy wished to exchange her for Zhao Quan and Qiu Fu.

sentences.zh: 本兵許論以為便，乃遣桃松寨夜逸出塞，紿之西走，陰告辛愛，辛愛執而戮之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Xu Lun thought this expedient; they sent Taosongzhai to slip out of the frontier by night, deceived her into fleeing west, secretly informed Xing'ai, and Xing'ai seized and executed her.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Xu Lun thought this expedient. They sent Taosongzhai to slip out of the frontier by night, tricked her into fleeing west, secretly informed Xing'ai, and Xing'ai seized and executed her.

sentences.zh: 敵狎知順無能，圍右衛益急，更分兵犯宣、薊鎮。

translations.literal: The enemy, having grown familiar with Shun's incompetence, pressed the siege of Right Guard more urgently and further divided troops to raid Xuan and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Having grown familiar with Yang Shun's incompetence, the enemy pressed the siege of Right Guard more urgently and sent separate columns to raid Xuanfu and Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 西鄙震動，右衛烽火斷絕者六閱月。

translations.literal: The western frontier was shaken; beacon fires from Right Guard were cut off for six months.
translations.idiomatic: The western frontier was thrown into turmoil. Beacon fires from Right Guard went unanswered for six months.

sentences.zh: 大學士嚴嵩與許論議，欲棄右衛。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yan Song and Xu Lun deliberated and wished to abandon Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yan Song and Xu Lun deliberated and proposed abandoning Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 帝不聽，詔諸臣發兵措餉，而以兵部侍郎江東代順。

translations.literal: The emperor would not listen; he ordered the ministers to dispatch troops and arrange supplies, and replaced Shun with Vice Minister of War Jiang Dong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused. He ordered the ministers to dispatch troops and arrange supplies, and replaced Yang Shun with Vice Minister of War Jiang Dong.

sentences.zh: 時故將尚表以饋餉入圍城，悉力捍禦，粟盡食牛馬，徹屋為薪，士卒無變志。

translations.literal: At that time the former general Shang Biao, bringing provisions into the besieged city, exerted all his strength in defense; when grain was exhausted they ate cattle and horses, tore down houses for firewood, and the soldiers did not waver in resolve.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the veteran general Shang Biao, bringing provisions into the besieged city, defended with all his strength. When grain ran out they ate cattle and horses, tore down houses for firewood, and the soldiers never wavered.

sentences.zh: 表時出兵突戰，獲俺答孫及婿與其部將各一人。

translations.literal: From time to time Biao sallied forth to strike in battle and captured Altan's grandson and son-in-law along with one of his tribal generals each.
translations.idiomatic: From time to time Shang Biao sallied forth and captured Altan's grandson, his son-in-law, and one tribal general apiece.

sentences.zh: 會帝所遣侍郎江東及巡撫楊選、總兵張承勳等各嚴兵進，圍乃解。

translations.literal: Just then Vice Minister Jiang Dong sent by the emperor, together with Grand Coordinator Yang Xuan, Supreme Commander Zhang Chengxun, and others, each advanced with strict troops, and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Vice Minister Jiang Dong, dispatched by the emperor, together with Grand Coordinator Yang Xuan, Supreme Commander Zhang Chengxun, and others, each advanced with disciplined troops, and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 復掠永昌、涼州及宣府赤城，圍甘州十四日始退。

translations.literal: They again plundered Yongchang, Liangzhou, and Chicheng in Xuanfu, and besieged Ganzhou for fourteen days before withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy again plundered Yongchang, Liangzhou, and Chicheng in Xuanfu, and besieged Ganzhou for fourteen days before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 土蠻亦數寇遼東。

translations.literal: Tumen also raided Liaodong several times.
translations.idiomatic: Tumen Khan also raided Liaodong repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 三十八年春，老把都、辛愛謀大舉入犯，駐會州，使其諜詭稱東下。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, La Batu and Xing'ai planned a major invasion, encamped at Huizhou, and had their spies falsely claim they were moving east.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, La Batu and Xing'ai planned a major invasion, encamped at Huizhou, and had their spies falsely claim they were moving east.

sentences.zh: 總督王忬不能察，遽分兵而東，號令數易，敵遂乘間入薊鎮潘家口，忬得罪。

translations.literal: Governor-General Wang Xu could not detect this, hastily divided troops and moved east, changed orders several times, and the enemy seized the opening to enter Panjiakou in Jizhou; Xu was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wang Xu failed to see through the ruse, hastily divided his troops and moved east, changed orders repeatedly, and the enemy seized the opening to enter Panjiakou in Jizhou. Wang Xu was punished.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯大同，轉掠宣府東西二城，駐內地旬日，會久雨乃退。

translations.literal: In summer they raided Datong, then turned to plunder the eastern and western cities of Xuanfu, encamped in the interior for ten days, and withdrew only when prolonged rains set in.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they raided Datong, then turned to plunder the eastern and western cities of Xuanfu. They encamped inside the frontier for ten days and withdrew only when heavy rains set in.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，敵聚眾喜峰口外，窺犯薊鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year the enemy gathered troops outside Xifeng Pass, watching for an opportunity to raid Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year the enemy gathered troops outside Xifeng Pass, watching for an opportunity to strike Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 大同總兵劉漢出搗其帳於灰河，敵稍遠徙。

translations.literal: Datong Supreme Commander Liu Han went out to strike their camp at Huihe; the enemy withdrew somewhat farther.
translations.idiomatic: Datong supreme commander Liu Han raided their camp at Huihe, and the enemy withdrew farther away.

sentences.zh: 秋，漢復與參將王孟夏等搗豐州，擒斬一百五十人，焚板升略盡。

translations.literal: In autumn Han again, with Regimental Commander Wang Mengxia and others, raided Fengzhou, capturing and beheading one hundred fifty men and burning the bansheng settlements nearly to completion.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn Liu Han again, with regimental commander Wang Mengxia and others, raided Fengzhou, capturing and beheading one hundred fifty men and burning the bansheng settlements nearly to completion.

sentences.zh: 是歲，寇大同、延綏、薊、遼邊無虛日。

translations.literal: That year they raided the borders of Datong, Yan'an, Ji, and Liaodong without a single idle day.
translations.idiomatic: That year they raided the borders of Datong, Yan'an, Jizhou, and Liaodong without a single idle day.

sentences.zh: 明年春，敵自河西踏冰入寇，守備王世臣、千戶李虎戰死。

translations.literal: The next spring the enemy crossed the frozen Hexi frontier to raid; Defense Commander Wang Shichen and Centurion Li Hu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the enemy crossed the frozen Hexi frontier to raid. Defense Commander Wang Shichen and Centurion Li Hu were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 秋，犯宣府及居庸。

translations.literal: In autumn they raided Xuanfu and Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn they raided Xuanfu and Juyong.

sentences.zh: 冬，掠陝西、寧夏塞。

translations.literal: In winter they plundered the frontiers of Shaanxi and Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In winter they plundered the frontiers of Shaanxi and Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 已，復分兵而東，陷蓋州。

translations.literal: Afterward they again divided troops and moved east, taking Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward they again divided their forces and moved east, capturing Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 四十一年夏，土蠻入撫順，為總兵黑春所敗。

translations.literal: In the summer of the forty-first year Tumen entered Fushun and was defeated by Supreme Commander Hei Chun.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the forty-first year Tumen Khan entered Fushun and was defeated by supreme commander Hei Chun.

sentences.zh: 冬，復攻鳳凰城，春力戰二日夜，死之。

translations.literal: In winter they again attacked Fenghuang Fort; Chun fought fiercely for two days and nights and died.
translations.idiomatic: In winter they again attacked Fenghuang Fort. Hei Chun fought fiercely for two days and nights and was killed.

sentences.zh: 海、金殺掠尤甚。

translations.literal: The killing and plundering in Hai and Jin were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: The killing and plundering in Hai and Jin were especially severe.

sentences.zh: 冬，俺答數犯山西、寧夏塞。

translations.literal: In winter Altan repeatedly raided the frontiers of Shanxi and Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Altan repeatedly raided the frontiers of Shanxi and Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 延綏總兵趙岢分部銳卒，令裨將李希靖等東出神木堡，搗敵帳於半坡山，徐執中等西出定邊營，擊敵騎於荍麥湖，皆勝之，斬一百十九級。

translations.literal: Yan'an Supreme Commander Zhao Ke deployed picked troops in separate detachments, ordering Lieutenant General Li Xijing and others east from Shenmu Fort to raid the enemy camp at Banpo Mountain, while Xu Zhizhong and others west from Dingbian Camp struck enemy horsemen at Qiaomai Lake—all were victorious, beheading one hundred nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: Yan'an supreme commander Zhao Ke deployed picked troops in separate columns. He sent lieutenant general Li Xijing and others east from Shenmu Fort to raid the enemy camp at Banpo Mountain, while Xu Zhizhong and others marched west from Dingbian Camp to strike enemy horsemen at Qiaomai Lake. Both columns were victorious, taking one hundred nineteen heads.

sentences.zh: 四十二年春，敵入宣府滴水崖，劉漢卻之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the forty-second year the enemy entered Dishui Cliff in Xuanfu; Liu Han repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the forty-second year the enemy entered Dishui Cliff in Xuanfu. Liu Han repelled them.

sentences.zh: 敵遂引而東，數犯遼塞。

translations.literal: The enemy then withdrew east and repeatedly raided the Liaodong frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy then withdrew east and repeatedly raided the Liaodong frontier.

sentences.zh: 秋，總兵楊照敗死。

translations.literal: In autumn Supreme Commander Yang Zhao was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn supreme commander Yang Zhao was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 時薊遼總督楊選囚縶三衛長通罕，令其諸子更迭為質。

translations.literal: At that time Ji-Liao Governor-General Yang Xuan imprisoned the Three Guards chieftain Tonghan and required his sons to serve in rotation as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ji-Liao governor-general Yang Xuan imprisoned the Three Guards chieftain Tonghan and required his sons to serve in rotation as hostages.

sentences.zh: 通罕者，辛愛妻父也，冀以牽制辛愛，三衛皆怨。

translations.literal: Tonghan was Xing'ai's wife's father; they hoped to use this to restrain Xing'ai, and all Three Guards resented it.
translations.idiomatic: Tonghan was Xing'ai's father-in-law. The Ming hoped this would restrain Xing'ai, but all Three Guards resented the move.

sentences.zh: 冬，大掠順義、三河。

translations.literal: In winter they plundered heavily in Shunyi and Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: In winter they plundered heavily in Shunyi and Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 諸將趙溱、孫臏戰死，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Generals Zhao Qin and Sun Bin died in battle, and the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Zhao Qin and Sun Bin were killed in battle, and the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 大同總兵姜應熊御之於密雲，敗之，敵退。

translations.literal: Datong Supreme Commander Jiang Yingxiong met them at Miyun and defeated them; the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Datong supreme commander Jiang Yingxiong met them at Miyun and defeated them, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 詔誅選。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xuan's execution.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yang Xuan's execution.

sentences.zh: 明年，土蠻入遼東，都御史劉燾上諸將守禦功，言海水暴漲，敵騎多沒者。

translations.literal: The next year Tumen entered Liaodong; Censor-in-Chief Liu Tao submitted the defensive achievements of the generals, saying the sea waters rose violently and many enemy horsemen were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Tumen Khan entered Liaodong. Censor-in-Chief Liu Tao submitted reports on the generals' defensive achievements, noting that the sea waters rose violently and many enemy horsemen were drowned.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「海若效靈。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The sea god has manifested efficacy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The sea god has shown his power.

sentences.zh: 」下有司祭告，燾等皆有賞。

translations.literal: " He ordered the officials to perform sacrificial rites and report, and Tao and the others all received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the officials to perform sacrificial rites and report back, and Liu Tao and the others all received rewards.

sentences.zh: 冬，敵犯狹西，大掠板橋、響閘兒諸處。

translations.literal: In winter the enemy raided Shaanxi and plundered heavily at Banqiao, Xiang'er, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In winter the enemy raided Shaanxi and plundered heavily at Banqiao, Xiang'er, and other places.

sentences.zh: 四十四年春，犯遼東寧前小團山，參將線補袞、游擊楊維籓死之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the forty-fourth year they raided Xiaotuanshan in Ningqian, Liaodong; Regimental Commander Xian Bugun and Mobile Corps Commander Yang Weifan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the forty-fourth year they raided Xiaotuanshan in Ningqian, Liaodong. Regimental commander Xian Bugun and mobile corps commander Yang Weifan were killed.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯肅州，總兵劉承業御之，再戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In summer they raided Suzhou; Supreme Commander Liu Chengye met them and won two battles in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In summer they raided Suzhou. Supreme commander Liu Chengye met them and won two battles in succession.

sentences.zh: 秋，俺答子黃台吉帥輕騎，自宣府洗馬林突入，散掠內地。

translations.literal: In autumn Altan's son Hongtaiji led light horsemen and suddenly entered from Ximolin in Xuanfu, scattering to plunder the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn Altan's son Hongtaiji led light horsemen and suddenly entered from Ximolin in Xuanfu, scattering to plunder the interior.

sentences.zh: 把總姜汝棟以銳卒二百伏暗莊堡，猝遇台吉，搏之。

translations.literal: Company Commander Jiang Rudong, with two hundred picked troops, lay in ambush at Anzhuang Fort, suddenly encountered Hongtaiji, and grappled with him.
translations.idiomatic: Company commander Jiang Rudong, with two hundred picked troops, lay in ambush at Anzhuang Fort, suddenly encountered Hongtaiji, and grappled with him.

sentences.zh: 台吉墮馬，為所部奪去。

translations.literal: Huangtaiji fell from his horse and was carried off by his own followers.
translations.idiomatic: Huangtaiji was thrown from his horse and borne away by his own men.

sentences.zh: 台吉受傷，越日始蘇。

translations.literal: Huangtaiji was wounded and did not regain consciousness until the next day.
translations.idiomatic: Huangtaiji was badly wounded and did not come to until the following day.

sentences.zh: 明年，俺答屢犯東西諸塞。

translations.literal: The next year Altan repeatedly violated the eastern and western frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Altan struck the eastern and western frontier passes again and again.

sentences.zh: 夏，清河守備郎得功扼之張能峪口，勝之。

translations.literal: In summer Defense Commander Lang Degong of Qinghe blocked them at Zhangnengyukou and won.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Defense Commander Lang Degong of Qinghe held them at Zhangnengyukou and won the day.

sentences.zh: 冬，大同參將崔世榮禦敵於樊皮嶺，及子大朝、大賓俱戰死。

translations.literal: In winter Datong Assistant Commander Cui Shirong met the enemy at Fanpiling; he and his sons Dazhao and Dabin all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Datong Assistant Commander Cui Shirong met the enemy at Fanpiling. He and his sons Dazhao and Dabin were all killed in action.

sentences.zh: 時丘富死，趙全在敵中益用事，尊俺答為帝，治宮殿。

translations.literal: At this time Qiu Fu had died; Zhao Quan grew ever more influential among the enemy, honoring Altan as emperor and building palaces for him.
translations.idiomatic: By then Qiu Fu was dead. Zhao Quan wielded still greater influence among the enemy, treating Altan as an emperor and raising palaces for him.

sentences.zh: 期日上棟，忽大風，棟墜傷數人。

translations.literal: On the day set for raising the ridgepole a sudden great wind struck; the beam fell and injured several men.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the ridgepole was to be raised, a sudden gale struck. The beam crashed down and injured several men.

sentences.zh: 俺答懼，不敢復居。

translations.literal: Altan was frightened and dared not live there again.
translations.idiomatic: Altan was terrified and would not live there again.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎譚綸在薊鎮善治兵，全乃說俺答無輕犯薊，大同兵弱，可以逞。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Tan Lun was stationed at Jizhou and skilled at training troops; Zhao Quan then advised Altan not to lightly violate Jizhou—the Datong garrison was weak and he could indulge himself there.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of War Tan Lun held Jizhou and was adept at drilling troops. Zhao Quan then urged Altan not to lightly strike Jizhou—Datong's defenses were weak, and there he could raid at will.

sentences.zh: 二年，敵犯柴溝，守備韓尚忠戰死。

translations.literal: In the second year the enemy violated Chaigou; Defense Commander Han Shangzhong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the enemy struck Chaigou. Defense Commander Han Shangzhong was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 時兵部侍郎王崇古鎮西邊，總兵李成梁守遼東，數以兵邀擊於塞外。

translations.literal: At this time Vice Minister of War Wang Chonggu guarded the western frontier and Supreme Commander Li Chengliang held Liaodong; both repeatedly intercepted the enemy beyond the frontier with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of War Wang Chonggu then held the western frontier and Supreme Commander Li Chengliang guarded Liaodong. Both repeatedly waylaid the enemy beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 敵知有備，入寇稍稀。

translations.literal: The enemy, knowing defenses were in place, raided somewhat less often.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the frontier well prepared, the enemy raided less often.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，黃台吉寇錦州，總兵王治道、參將郎得功以十餘騎入敵死。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year Huangtaiji raided Jinzhou; Supreme Commander Wang Zhidao and Assistant Commander Lang Degong charged into the enemy with a dozen horsemen and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year Huangtaiji raided Jinzhou. Supreme Commander Wang Zhidao and Assistant Commander Lang Degong led a dozen horsemen straight into the enemy and were killed.

sentences.zh: 冬，俺答有孫曰把漢那吉者，俺答第三子鐵背台吉子也，幼孤，育於俺答妻所。

translations.literal: In winter Altan had a grandson named Bahananji, son of Altan's third son Tiebei Huangtaiji; orphaned young, he was raised in Altan's wife's household.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Altan had a grandson named Bahananji, the son of his third son Tiebei Huangtaiji. Orphaned young, he was raised in Altan's wife's household.

sentences.zh: 既長，娶婦比吉。

translations.literal: When he came of age he took a wife named Biji.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age he married a woman named Biji.

sentences.zh: 把漢復聘襖兒都司女，即俺答外孫女，貌美，俺答奪之。

translations.literal: Bahan also betrothed a daughter of the A'er Dusi—that is, Altan's granddaughter—who was beautiful; Altan seized her for himself.
translations.idiomatic: Bahan had also betrothed a daughter of the A'er Dusi, Altan's own granddaughter, renowned for her beauty. Altan took her for himself.

sentences.zh: 把漢恚，遂率其屬阿力哥等十人來降。

translations.literal: Bahan, enraged, then led his followers Ailege and nine others to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Furious, Bahan led his followers Ailege and nine others to defect to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 大同巡撫方逢時受之，以告總督王崇古。

translations.literal: Datong Grand Coordinator Fang Fengshi received them and reported to Governor Wang Chonggu.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Grand Coordinator Fang Fengshi received them and reported to Governor Wang Chonggu.

sentences.zh: 崇古上言：「把漢來歸，非擁眾內附者比，宜給官爵，豐館餼，飭輿馬，以示俺答。

translations.literal: Chonggu memorialized: "Bahan's coming over is not like those who lead masses to defect inward; he should be given office and rank, generous lodging and rations, and proper carriages and horses, to show Altan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chonggu memorialized: "Bahan's defection is not the usual case of a chieftain leading his horde inward. We should grant him office and rank, generous lodging and provisions, and proper mounts and carriages—so Altan may see how he is treated.

sentences.zh: 俺答急，則使縛送板升諸叛人；

translations.literal: If Altan grows desperate, then have him bind and send the Bansheng defectors;
translations.idiomatic: If Altan grows desperate, make him bind and deliver the Bansheng defectors;

sentences.zh: 不聽，即脅誅把漢牽沮之；

translations.literal: if he refuses, then threaten to execute Bahan to check him;
translations.idiomatic: if he refuses, threaten to execute Bahan to restrain him;

sentences.zh: 又不然，因而撫納，如漢置屬國居烏桓故事，使招其故部，徙近塞。

translations.literal: or, failing that, receive and settle him as Han once placed dependent states among the Wuhuan—have him summon his old following and move them near the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: or, if not that, settle him as the Han once settled dependent states among the Wuhuan—let him summon his old following and move them near the passes.

sentences.zh: 俺答老且死，黃台吉立，則令把漢還，以其眾與台吉抗，我按兵助之。

translations.literal: When Altan grows old and dies and Huangtaiji succeeds, then have Bahan return; with his followers he can resist Huangtaiji, and we can hold our troops in reserve to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan grows old and dies and Huangtaiji succeeds, send Bahan back. With his followers he can stand against Huangtaiji, and we can hold our armies in reserve to support him.

sentences.zh: 」詔可，授把漢指揮使，阿力哥正千戶。

translations.literal: " An edict approved this; Bahan was appointed Commander, and Ailege Regular Company Commander.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved. Bahan was appointed Commander, and Ailege Regular Company Commander.

sentences.zh: 俺答方西掠吐番，聞之亟引還，約諸部入犯，崇古檄諸道嚴兵御之。

translations.literal: Altan was then raiding Tibet in the west; hearing this he hurried back, mustered the tribes to invade, and Chonggu ordered all circuits to ready troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Altan was raiding Tibet in the west. Hearing the news he hurried back, called the tribes to arms, and Wang Chonggu ordered every circuit to stand ready.

sentences.zh: 敵使來請命，崇古遣譯者鮑崇德往，言朝廷待把漢甚厚，第能縛板升諸叛人趙全等，旦送至，把漢即夕返矣。

translations.literal: The enemy sent envoys to plead; Chonggu dispatched the interpreter Bao Chongde, who said the court had treated Bahan very generously and that if Altan could only bind the Bansheng defectors Zhao Quan and the others and deliver them by dawn, Bahan would return that very evening.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy sent envoys to sue for peace. Wang Chonggu sent the interpreter Bao Chongde, who told them the court had treated Bahan with great honor—and that if Altan would bind the Bansheng defectors Zhao Quan and the rest and deliver them by dawn, Bahan would return that same night.

sentences.zh: 俺答大喜，屏人語曰：「我不為亂，亂由全等。

translations.literal: Altan was greatly pleased and, dismissing others, said in private: "I do not make trouble; trouble comes from Quan and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Altan was overjoyed. Sending the others away, he said privately, "I do not make trouble—trouble comes from Quan and his followers.

sentences.zh: 若天子幸封我為王，長北方諸部，孰敢為患？

translations.literal: If the Son of Heaven will deign to ennoble me as king over the northern tribes, who would dare make trouble?
translations.idiomatic: If the Son of Heaven will deign to ennoble me king over the northern tribes, who would dare raise trouble?

sentences.zh: 即死，吾孫當襲封，彼衣食中國，忍倍德乎？

translations.literal: Even when I die, my grandson will inherit the title; fed and clothed by China, could he betray its grace?
translations.idiomatic: When I die, my grandson will inherit the title. Fed and clothed by China, how could he betray its grace?

sentences.zh: 」乃益發使與崇德來乞封，且請輸馬，與中國鐵鍋、布帛互市，隨執趙全、李自馨等數人來獻。

translations.literal: " He then sent more envoys with Chongde to beg enfeoffment and to request to offer horses in exchange for iron pots, cloth, and silk at mutual markets, and at the same time seized Zhao Quan, Li Zixin, and several others and brought them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " He then sent more envoys with Chongde to beg enfeoffment, to offer horses in exchange for iron pots, cloth, and silk at mutual markets, and at the same time delivered Zhao Quan, Li Zixin, and several others bound as tribute.

sentences.zh: 崇古乃以帝命遣把漢歸，把漢猶戀戀，感泣再拜去。

translations.literal: Chonggu then, by the emperor's command, sent Bahan back; Bahan still lingered, weeping and bowing twice before departing.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial command Wang Chonggu sent Bahan back. Bahan lingered still, weeping as he bowed twice and took his leave.

sentences.zh: 俺答得孫大喜，上表謝。

translations.literal: Altan, regaining his grandson, was greatly pleased and submitted a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Altan, having recovered his grandson, was overjoyed and submitted a memorial of thanks.

sentences.zh: 崇古因上言：「朝廷若允俺答封貢，諸邊有數年之安，可乘時修備。

translations.literal: Chonggu therefore memorialized: "If the court grants Altan enfeoffment and tribute, the frontiers will have several years of peace, and we can use the time to strengthen defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chonggu therefore memorialized: "If the court grants Altan enfeoffment and tribute, the frontiers will know several years of peace, and we can use the interval to strengthen our defenses.

sentences.zh: 設敵背盟，吾以數年蓄養之財力，從事戰守，愈於終歲奔命，自救不暇者矣。

translations.literal: Should the enemy break faith, we can then fight and defend with several years' accumulated wealth and strength—better than spending the whole year in emergency, barely able to save ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: Should they break faith, we can fight and hold with several years' accumulated wealth and strength—far better than racing year-round in emergency, barely able to save ourselves.

sentences.zh: 」復條八事以請。

translations.literal: " He also listed eight points in his request.
translations.idiomatic: " He also set forth eight points in his request.

sentences.zh: 一，議封號官爵。

translations.literal: First, discuss titles and official ranks.
translations.idiomatic: First, settle titles and official ranks.

sentences.zh: 諸部行輩，俺答為尊，宜錫以王號，給印信。

translations.literal: Among the tribes by seniority Altan is foremost; he should be granted a princely title and given a seal.
translations.idiomatic: Among the tribes Altan stands first in seniority; he should receive a princely title and an official seal.

sentences.zh: 其大枝如老把都、黃台吉及吉囊長子吉能等，俱宜授以都督。

translations.literal: Major branches such as Laobadou, Huangtaiji, and Jinang's eldest son Jineng should all be appointed Regional Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Major branches such as Laobadou, Huangtaiji, and Jinang's eldest son Jineng should all be appointed Regional Commanders.

sentences.zh: 弟侄子孫如兀慎打兒漢等四十六枝，授以指揮。

translations.literal: Younger brothers, nephews, and grandsons—forty-six branches such as Wushen Da'erhan—should be appointed Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brothers, nephews, and grandsons—forty-six branches such as Wushen Da'erhan—should receive appointments as Commanders.

sentences.zh: 其俺答諸婿十餘枝，授以千戶。

translations.literal: Altan's dozen-odd sons-in-law in their branches should be appointed Company Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Altan's dozen-odd sons-in-law and their branches should be appointed Company Commanders.

sentences.zh: 一，定貢額。

translations.literal: Second, fix the tribute quota.
translations.idiomatic: Second, fix the tribute quota.

sentences.zh: 每歲一入貢，俺答馬十匹，使十人。

translations.literal: Each year one tribute mission: Altan ten horses and ten envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Once each year they would tribute: Altan ten horses and ten envoys.

sentences.zh: 老把都、吉能、黃台吉八匹，使四人。

translations.literal: Laobadou, Jineng, and Huangtaiji eight horses and four envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Laobadou, Jineng, and Huangtaiji eight horses and four envoys.

sentences.zh: 諸部長各以部落大小為差，大者四匹，小者二匹，使各二人。

translations.literal: Each tribal chief according to the size of his following—the larger four horses, the smaller two, each with two envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Each tribal chief according to the size of his following: the larger four horses, the smaller two, each with two envoys.

sentences.zh: 通計歲貢馬不得過五百匹，使不得過百五十人。

translations.literal: In total the yearly tribute horses must not exceed five hundred, and envoys one hundred fifty.
translations.idiomatic: In all, yearly tribute horses must not exceed five hundred, and envoys one hundred fifty.

sentences.zh: 馬分三等，上駟三十進御，余給價有差，老瘠者不入。

translations.literal: Horses were divided into three grades; the finest thirty were presented to the throne, the rest purchased at graded prices, and old or lean ones not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Horses would be graded in three classes: the finest thirty presented to the throne, the rest purchased at set prices, and old or lean animals rejected.

sentences.zh: 其使，歲許六十人進京，余待境上。

translations.literal: Of the envoys, sixty each year would be permitted to enter the capital; the rest would wait at the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Of the envoys, sixty each year would be permitted to enter the capital; the rest would wait at the border.

sentences.zh: 使還，聽以馬價市繒布諸物。

translations.literal: When the envoys returned, they were permitted to use the horse price to buy silk, cloth, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: On their return, envoys might use the horse price to buy silk, cloth, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 給酬賞，其賞額視三衛及西蕃諸國。

translations.literal: Rewards would be given, the amounts matching those for the Three Guards and the western Tibetan states.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards would be granted on the same scale as for the Three Guards and the western Tibetan states.

sentences.zh: 一，議貢期、貢道。

translations.literal: Third, discuss tribute seasons and routes.
translations.idiomatic: Third, set tribute seasons and routes.

sentences.zh: 以春月及萬壽聖節四方來同之會，使人，馬匹及表文自大同左衛驗入，給犒賞。

translations.literal: In spring and at the Emperor's Longevity Festival, when envoys from all quarters assemble, horses, envoys, and memorials would enter through inspection at Datong Left Guard and receive frontier rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In spring and at the Emperor's Longevity Festival, when envoys from all quarters assemble, horses, envoys, and memorials would enter through inspection at Datong Left Guard and receive frontier rewards.

sentences.zh: 駐邊者，分送各城撫鎮驗賞。

translations.literal: Those remaining at the frontier would be sent in groups to the various cities for inspection and reward by the grand coordinators and supreme commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Those remaining at the frontier would be sent in groups to the various garrison cities for inspection and reward by the grand coordinators and supreme commanders.

sentences.zh: 入京者，押送自居庸關入。

translations.literal: Those entering the capital would be escorted in through Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Those bound for the capital would be escorted in through Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 一，立互市。

translations.literal: Fourth, establish mutual markets.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, establish mutual markets.

sentences.zh: 其規如弘治初，北部三貢例。

translations.literal: The regulations would follow the early Hongzhi precedent for the northern three-tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations would follow the early Hongzhi precedent for the northern tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 蕃以金、銀、牛馬、皮張、馬尾等物，商販以緞紬、布匹、釜鍋等物。

translations.literal: The tribes would bring gold, silver, cattle, horses, hides, and horsehair; merchants would bring satin, silk, cloth, and iron pots.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes would bring gold, silver, cattle, horses, hides, and horsehair; merchants would bring satin, silk, cloth, and iron pots.

sentences.zh: 開市日，來者以三百人駐邊外，宣府應於萬全右衛、張家口邊外，山西應於水泉營邊外。

translations.literal: On market days three hundred men would be stationed outside the frontier; Xuanfu would respond at Wanquan Right Guard and Zhangjiakou, and Shanxi at Shuiquanying.
translations.idiomatic: On market days three hundred men would be stationed outside the passes: Xuanfu at Wanquan Right Guard and Zhangjiakou, Shanxi at Shuiquanying.

sentences.zh: 一，議撫賞。

translations.literal: Fifth, discuss frontier gifts and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, set frontier gifts and rewards.

sentences.zh: 守市兵人布二匹，部長緞二匹、紬二匹。

translations.literal: Market guards two bolts of cloth each; tribal chiefs two bolts of satin and two of silk each.
translations.idiomatic: Market guards would receive two bolts of cloth each; tribal chiefs two bolts of satin and two of silk each.

sentences.zh: 以好至邊者，酌來使大小，量加賞犒。

translations.literal: For those coming in goodwill to the frontier, rewards would be added according to the rank of the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: For those coming in goodwill to the frontier, additional rewards would be granted according to the envoys' rank.

sentences.zh: 一，議歸降。

translations.literal: Sixth, discuss those who surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, settle policy on those who surrender.

sentences.zh: 通貢後，降者不分有罪無罪，免收納。

translations.literal: After tribute relations were established, surrendering parties would be received regardless of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Once tribute relations were established, those who surrendered would be received regardless of guilt.

sentences.zh: 其華人被擄歸正者，查別無竊盜，乃許入。

translations.literal: Chinese captives returning to allegiance would be admitted only after inquiry found no record of theft.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese captives returning to allegiance would be admitted only after inquiry found no record of theft.

sentences.zh: 一，審經權。

translations.literal: Seventh, weigh principle against expediency.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, weigh principle against expediency.

sentences.zh: 一，戒狡飾。

translations.literal: Eighth, guard against deceit.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, guard against deceit.

sentences.zh: 疏入，下廷臣議。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, it was sent down for discussion among court officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, it was sent down for discussion among court officials.

sentences.zh: 帝終從崇古言，詔封俺答為順義王，賜紅蟒衣一襲；

translations.literal: The emperor finally followed Chonggu's advice and decreed that Altan be enfeoffed as Prince of Shun Righteousness and granted one robe of red python silk;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at last accepted Wang Chonggu's counsel and decreed that Altan be enfeoffed as Prince of Shun Righteousness, granting him one robe of red python silk;

sentences.zh: 昆都力哈、黃台吉授都督同知，各賜紅獅子衣一襲、彩幣四表裡；

translations.literal: Kunuliha and Huangtaiji were appointed Vice Regional Commanders, each granted one robe of red lion pattern and four layers of colored silks;
translations.idiomatic: Kunuliha and Huangtaiji were appointed Vice Regional Commanders, each granted a robe of red lion pattern and four layers of colored silks;

sentences.zh: 賓兔台吉等十人，授指揮同知；

translations.literal: Bintu Huangtaiji and ten others were appointed Assistant Regional Commanders;
translations.idiomatic: Bintu Huangtaiji and ten others were appointed Assistant Regional Commanders;

sentences.zh: 那木兒台吉等十九人，授指揮僉事；

translations.literal: Namier Huangtaiji and nineteen others were appointed Junior Assistant Regional Commanders;
translations.idiomatic: Namier Huangtaiji and nineteen others were appointed Junior Assistant Regional Commanders;

sentences.zh: 打兒漢台吉等十八人，授正千戶；

translations.literal: Da'erhan Huangtaiji and eighteen others were appointed Regular Company Commanders;
translations.idiomatic: Da'erhan Huangtaiji and eighteen others were appointed Regular Company Commanders;

sentences.zh: 阿拜台吉等十二人，授副千戶；

translations.literal: Abai Huangtaiji and twelve others were appointed Vice Company Commanders;
translations.idiomatic: Abai Huangtaiji and twelve others were appointed Vice Company Commanders;

sentences.zh: 恰台吉等二人，授百戶。

translations.literal: Qia Huangtaiji and two others were appointed Platoon Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Qia Huangtaiji and two others were appointed Platoon Commanders.

sentences.zh: 昆都力哈，即老把都也。

translations.literal: Kunuliha—that is, Laobadou.
translations.idiomatic: Kunuliha was Laobadou.

sentences.zh: 兵部采崇古議，定市令。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War adopted Chonggu's proposals and fixed the market regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War adopted Wang Chonggu's proposals and fixed the market regulations.

sentences.zh: 秋市成，凡得馬五百餘匹，賜俺答等彩幣有差。

translations.literal: The autumn market was established; in all more than five hundred horses were obtained, and Altan and the others were granted graded colored silks.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn market opened. More than five hundred horses were obtained in all, and Altan and the others received graded gifts of colored silk.

sentences.zh: 西部吉能及其侄切盡等亦請市，詔予市紅山墩暨清水營。

translations.literal: Jineng of the western tribes and his nephew Qiejin also requested markets; an edict granted markets at Hongshandun and Qingshuiying.
translations.idiomatic: Jineng of the western tribes and his nephew Qiejin also requested markets; an edict granted markets at Hongshandun and Qingshuiying.

sentences.zh: 市成，亦封吉能為都督同知。

translations.literal: When the markets were established, Jineng was also enfeoffed as Vice Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Once the markets were established, Jineng was also enfeoffed as Vice Regional Commander.

sentences.zh: 已而俺答請金字經及剌麻僧，詔給之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Altan requested a gold-letter sutra and lamas; an edict granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Altan requested a gold-letter sutra and lamas; an edict granted both.

sentences.zh: 崇古復請玉印，詔予鍍金銀印。

translations.literal: Chonggu again requested a jade seal; an edict granted a gold-plated silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chonggu again requested a jade seal; an edict granted a gold-plated silver seal instead.

sentences.zh: 俺答老佞佛，復請於海南建寺，詔賜寺額仰華。

translations.literal: Altan in his old age was devoted to Buddhism and again requested to build a temple south of the sea; an edict granted the temple name Yanghua.
translations.idiomatic: Altan in his old age was devoted to Buddhism and again asked to build a temple south of the sea; an edict granted the temple the name Yanghua.

sentences.zh: 俺答常遠處青山，二子，曰賓兔，居松山，直蘭州之北，曰丙兔，居西海，直河州之西，並求互市，多桀驁。

translations.literal: Altan often stayed far off in the green mountains. He had two sons: Bintu, who lived at Songshan directly north of Lanzhou, and Bingtu, who lived at the Western Sea directly west of Hezhou; both sought mutual markets and were often unruly.
translations.idiomatic: Altan often stayed far off in the green mountains. He had two sons: Bintu, who lived at Songshan directly north of Lanzhou, and Bingtu, who lived at the Western Sea directly west of Hezhou. Both sought mutual markets and were often unruly.

sentences.zh: 俺答諭之，亦漸馴。

translations.literal: Altan admonished them, and they gradually grew tame.
translations.idiomatic: Altan admonished them, and they gradually grew tame.

sentences.zh: 萬曆六年，成梁率游擊秦得倚等擊敵於東昌堡，斬部長九人，余級八百八十四，總督梁夢龍以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Wanli, Chengliang led Guerrilla Commander Qin Deyi and others to strike the enemy at Dongchang Fortress, beheading nine tribal chiefs and eight hundred eighty-four others in all; Governor Liang Menglong reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Wanli, Li Chengliang led Guerrilla Commander Qin Deyi and others against the enemy at Dongchang Fortress, killing nine tribal chiefs and eight hundred eighty-four others in all. Governor Liang Menglong reported the victory.

sentences.zh: 帝大悅，祭告郊廟，御皇極門宣捷。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased, offered sacrifice and report at the suburban altars, and proclaimed the victory at the Gate of Imperial Supremacy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased. He offered sacrifice at the suburban altars and proclaimed the victory at the Gate of Imperial Supremacy.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，土蠻四萬騎入錦川營。

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year Tumen entered with forty thousand horsemen at Jinchuanying.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the seventh year Tumen entered with forty thousand horsemen at Jinchuanying.

sentences.zh: 夢龍、成梁及總兵戚繼光等已預受大學士張居正方略，併力備御，敵始退。

translations.literal: Menglong, Chengliang, and Supreme Commander Qi Jiguang had already received Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng's strategy in advance and combined forces to defend; the enemy then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Menglong, Li Chengliang, and Supreme Commander Qi Jiguang had already received Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng's strategy and combined forces to defend. The enemy then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自是敵數入，成梁等數敗之，輒斬其巨魁，又時襲擊於塞外，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: From this time the enemy entered repeatedly; Chengliang and the others defeated them repeatedly, often beheading their great chiefs, and also raided beyond the frontier from time to time, taking many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the enemy raided repeatedly. Li Chengliang and his colleagues defeated them again and again, often killing their great chiefs, and also struck beyond the passes from time to time, taking many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 敵畏之，少戢，成梁遂以功封寧遠伯。

translations.literal: The enemy feared them and somewhat restrained themselves; Chengliang was therefore ennobled as Marquis of Ningyuan for his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy feared them and pulled back somewhat. Li Chengliang was therefore enfeoffed as Marquis of Ningyuan for his achievements.

sentences.zh: 俺答既就市，事朝廷甚謹。

translations.literal: Once Altan had entered the markets, he served the court with great scruple.
translations.idiomatic: Once Altan had entered the markets, he served the court with scrupulous care.

sentences.zh: 部下卒有掠奪邊氓者，必罰治之，且稽首謝罪，朝廷亦厚加賞賚。

translations.literal: If subordinates raided frontier commoners he invariably punished them and kowtowed in apology; the court also richly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: If his men raided frontier subjects he invariably punished them and kowtowed in apology. The court richly rewarded him in turn.

sentences.zh: 十年春，俺答死，帝特賜祭七壇、綵緞十二表裡、布百匹，示優恤。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year Altan died; the emperor specially granted seven sacrificial altars, twelve layers of colored silks, and one hundred bolts of cloth, showing special favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the tenth year Altan died. The emperor specially granted seven sacrificial altars, twelve layers of colored silks, and one hundred bolts of cloth in special condolence.

sentences.zh: 其妻哈屯率子黃台吉等，上表進馬謝，復賜幣布有差。

translations.literal: His wife Hatun led her son Huangtaiji and the others in submitting a memorial and offering horses in thanks; they were again granted graded silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Hatun led her son Huangtaiji and the others in submitting a memorial and offering horses in thanks. They received graded gifts of silk and cloth again.

sentences.zh: 封黃台吉為順義王，改名乞慶哈。

translations.literal: Huangtaiji was enfeoffed as Prince of Shun Righteousness and renamed Qiqingha.
translations.idiomatic: Huangtaiji was enfeoffed as Prince of Shun Righteousness and renamed Qiqingha.

sentences.zh: 立三歲而死，朝廷給恤典如例。

translations.literal: Three years after succeeding he died, and the court granted condolence rites as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: Three years after his succession he died, and the court granted him the full condolence rites due his rank.

sentences.zh: 十五年春，子撦力克嗣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year his son Chelik succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year his son Chelik succeeded.

sentences.zh: 其妻三娘子，故俺答所奪之外孫女而為婦者也，歷配三王，主兵柄，為中國守邊保塞，眾畏服之，乃敕封為忠順夫人，自宣大至甘肅不用兵者二十年。

translations.literal: His wife the Third Lady—originally Altan's seized granddaughter taken as wife—had been married to three khans in succession, held military power, guarded the frontier and protected the passes for China, and was feared and obeyed by all; she was therefore enfeoffed as Lady of Loyal Submission, and from Xuanfu and Datong to Gansu the frontier went twenty years without war.
translations.idiomatic: His wife the Third Lady—originally Altan's granddaughter, seized and made his wife—had been married to three khans in succession. She held military power, guarded the frontier and kept the passes for China, and all feared and obeyed her. She was therefore enfeoffed as Lady of Loyal Submission, and from Xuanfu and Datong to Gansu the frontier knew twenty years without war.

sentences.zh: 及撦力克西行遠邊，而套部莊禿賴等據水塘，卜失兔、火落赤等據莽剌、捏工兩川，數犯甘、涼、洮、氓、西寧間。

translations.literal: When Chelik marched far to the western frontier, the Ordos chieftain Zhuang Tulai and others held Shuitang, while Bushitu, Huoluochi, and others held the Mangla and Nie'gong valleys, repeatedly violating the regions between Gansu, Liangzhou, Tao, Min, and Xining.
translations.idiomatic: When Chelik marched far to the western frontier, the Ordos chieftain Zhuang Tulai held Shuitang while Bushitu, Huoluochi, and others held the Mangla and Nie'gong valleys, repeatedly striking the regions between Gansu, Liangzhou, Tao, Min, and Xining.

sentences.zh: 他部落亡慮數十種，出沒塞下，順逆不常。

translations.literal: Other tribes, numbering perhaps several dozen kinds, appeared and vanished below the frontier, compliant or hostile without fixed pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Other tribes, perhaps several dozen in all, appeared and vanished along the frontier, shifting between compliance and hostility without fixed pattern.

sentences.zh: 帝惡之，十九年詔並停撦力克市賞。

translations.literal: The emperor detested this; in the nineteenth year an edict suspended Chelik's markets and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was disgusted. In the nineteenth year an edict suspended Chelik's markets and rewards.

sentences.zh: 已而撦力克叩邊輸服，率眾東歸，獨莊禿賴、卜失兔等寇抄如故。

translations.literal: Before long Chelik came to the frontier to submit in defeat, led his followers east in return, only Zhuang Tulai, Bushitu, and others raiding and pillaging as before.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Chelik came to the frontier to submit, led his followers back east, while Zhuang Tulai, Bushitu, and the others kept raiding and pillaging as before.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，別部明安、土昧分犯榆林邊，總兵杜桐御之，斬獲五百人，殺明安。

translations.literal: That winter, from another division Ming An and Tumei separately invaded the Yulin frontier; regional commander Du Tong defended against them, beheaded and captured five hundred men, and killed Ming An.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Ming An and Tumei of another division separately struck the Yulin frontier. Regional commander Du Tong met them in battle, killed or captured five hundred men, and slew Ming An.

sentences.zh: 二十年，寧夏叛將哱拜等勾卜失兔、莊禿賴等，大舉入寇，總兵李如松擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the Ningxia rebel general Pabo and others incited Bushitu, Zhuang Tulai, and others to launch a major invasion; regional commander Li Rusong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Ningxia rebel Pabo and his allies incited Bushitu, Zhuang Tulai, and others to mount a major invasion. Regional commander Li Rusong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，延綏巡撫李春光奏：「套部納款已久，自明安被戮而寇恨深，西夏黨逆而貢市絕，延鎮連年多事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Yansui grand coordinator Li Chunguang memorialized: "The Ordos tribes have long submitted in good faith; since Ming An was executed their hatred for raiding runs deep, the Western Xia faction rebels and tribute markets cease, and Yan and the garrison have been troubled year after year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Yansui grand coordinator Li Chunguang memorialized: "The Ordos tribes have long pledged submission. Since Ming An was executed their thirst for vengeance runs deep; with Western Xia factions in rebellion the tribute markets have closed, and Yan and the garrisons have been embroiled year after year.

sentences.zh: 今東西各部皆乞款，而卜失兔挾私叵測，邊長兵寡，制御為難。

translations.literal: Now the eastern and western divisions all beg to submit, yet Bushitu harbors private designs impossible to fathom; the frontier is long and troops few, and control is difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Now the eastern and western divisions are all petitioning to submit, but Bushitu's private designs are impossible to read. The frontier is long, troops are few, and keeping control is hard.

sentences.zh: 宜察敵情，審時勢。

translations.literal: One should investigate enemy conditions and examine the times.
translations.idiomatic: We should read the enemy's intentions and weigh the situation carefully.

sentences.zh: 敵入犯則血戰，偶或小失，應寬吏議。

translations.literal: When the enemy invades one should fight to the blood; if there is occasional minor failure, leniency should be shown in deliberations on officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy invades we should fight without quarter; if commanders suffer the occasional minor setback, they should be spared harsh censure.

sentences.zh: 倘敵真心效順，相機議撫，不可忘戰備也。

translations.literal: If the enemy truly and sincerely submits in loyalty, one may take occasion to discuss pacification, but one must not forget war preparations.
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy genuinely seeks to submit, we can consider pacification as opportunity allows—but we must never neglect our defenses.

sentences.zh: 」帝命兵部傳飭各邊。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered the Ministry of War to transmit instructions to each frontier.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered the Ministry of War to relay instructions to all frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 秋，卜失兔入固原，游擊史見戰死。

translations.literal: In autumn Bushitu entered Guyuan; guerrilla commander Shi Jian died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Bushitu entered Guyuan. Guerrilla commander Shi Jian was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 延綏總兵麻貴御之，閱月始退。

translations.literal: Yansui regional commander Ma Gui defended against him; only after a full month did he withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Yansui regional commander Ma Gui held him off, and only after a full month did Bushitu withdraw.

sentences.zh: 全陝震動。

translations.literal: All Shaanxi was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: All of Shaanxi was alarmed.

sentences.zh: 其年，東部炒花犯鎮武堡，總兵董一元與戰，大破之。

translations.literal: That year, the eastern division Chao Hua violated Zhenwu Fort; regional commander Dong Yiyuan fought them and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chao Hua of the eastern division attacked Zhenwu Fort. Regional commander Dong Yiyuan met him in battle and routed him.

sentences.zh: 明年春，松部宰僧等犯陝西，總督葉夢熊督卻之。

translations.literal: The next spring, Zaiseng and others of the Song division violated Shaanxi; grand secretary Ye Mengxiong supervised and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Zaiseng and other leaders of the Song division invaded Shaanxi. Grand secretary Ye Mengxiong directed the defense and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 秋，海部永邵卜犯西寧，總督三邊李旼檄參將達雲、游擊白澤暨馬其撒、卜爾加諸屬番，設伏邀擊，大敗之，斬六百八十三級。

translations.literal: In autumn, Yong Shaobu of the Hai division violated Xining; grand secretary of the Three Frontiers Li Min dispatched orders to vice general Da Yun, guerrilla commander Bai Ze, and the subordinate Fan of Maqisa, Bu'erjia, and others to lay an ambush and intercept; they inflicted a great defeat and beheaded six hundred eighty-three.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Yong Shaobu of the Hai division struck at Xining. Three Frontiers grand secretary Li Min ordered vice general Da Yun, guerrilla commander Bai Ze, and the Fan chieftains Maqisa, Bu'erjia, and their followers to lay ambush and intercept. They won a crushing victory and took six hundred eighty-three heads.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，帝大悅，且以屬番效命，追敘前總制鄭雒功，賞賚並及雒。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived the emperor was greatly pleased; moreover, because the subordinate Fan had rendered loyal service, he retrospectively commended the former grand coordinator Zheng Luo's merit, and rewards extended to Luo as well.
translations.idiomatic: When word of the victory arrived the emperor was delighted. Because the subordinate Fan had fought loyally, he also retrospectively recognized the former grand coordinator Zheng Luo's achievement, and rewards were extended to Luo as well.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春，總督李釐以勁兵分三道出塞，襲卜失兔營，共斬四百九級，獲馬畜器械數千。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-fourth year, grand secretary Li Li led elite troops in three columns out beyond the passes, raided Bushitu's camp, beheaded four hundred nine in all, and captured several thousand horses, livestock, and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-fourth year grand secretary Li Li led crack troops in three columns beyond the frontier, struck Bushitu's camp, took four hundred nine heads, and seized thousands of horses, livestock, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 火落赤部眾復窺伺洮州，釐遣參將周國柱等擊之於莽剌川腦，斬一百三十六級。

translations.literal: Huoluochi's followers again watched and probed toward Taozhou; Li sent vice general Zhou Guozhu and others to strike them at the headwaters of the Mangla River and beheaded one hundred thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Huoluochi's followers again probed Taozhou. Li dispatched vice general Zhou Guozhu and others to meet them at the headwaters of the Mangla River and took one hundred thirty-six heads.

sentences.zh: 秋，著力兔、阿赤兔、火落赤等合謀犯西邊，炒花亦擁眾犯廣寧，守將皆嚴兵卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn, Zhuli Tu, Achitu, Huoluochi, and others conspired together to violate the western frontier; Chao Hua also led a host to violate Guangning, and the defending generals all with strict troops repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Zhuli Tu, Achitu, Huoluochi, and others joined in a coordinated strike on the western frontier. Chao Hua also led a large force against Guangning. The garrison commanders held them off with disciplined troops.

sentences.zh: 二十五年秋，海部寇甘鎮，官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year the Hai division raided Gansu garrison; government troops struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year the Hai division raided the Gansu garrison. Government troops beat them back.

sentences.zh: 冬，炒花糾土蠻諸部寇遼東，殺掠無算。

translations.literal: In winter Chao Hua gathered the Tuman tribes and others to raid Liaodong, killing and plundering beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Chao Hua rallied the Tuman and other tribes to raid Liaodong, killing and plundering without measure.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，復寇遼東，總兵李如松遠出搗巢，死之。

translations.literal: The next summer they again raided Liaodong; regional commander Li Rusong marched far out to strike their nest and died there.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer they raided Liaodong again. Regional commander Li Rusong led a deep strike against their camp and was killed.

sentences.zh: 冬，釐等分道出襲火落赤等於松山，走之，復其地。

translations.literal: In winter Li and others set out in separate routes to raid Huoluochi and others at Songshan, put them to flight, and recovered the territory.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Li and his colleagues marched in separate columns to strike Huoluochi and his followers at Songshan, drove them off, and recovered the territory.

sentences.zh: 二十七年詔復撦力克市賞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year an edict restored Chelik's markets and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year an edict restored Chelik's markets and rewards.

sentences.zh: 時釐等築松山，諸部紛叛，延、寧守臣共擊之，殺獲甲首幾三千。

translations.literal: At this time Li and others were building Songshan; the various divisions rebelled in succession; the defending officials of Yan and Ning jointly struck them and killed or captured nearly three thousand armored chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: While Li and his colleagues were fortifying Songshan, the various tribes rebelled one after another. The garrison commanders of Yan and Ning joined forces against them and killed or captured nearly three thousand armored chiefs.

sentences.zh: 明年，著力兔、宰僧、莊禿賴等乞通款，不許。

translations.literal: The next year Zhuli Tu, Zaiseng, Zhuang Tulai, and others begged to open relations of submission; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Zhuli Tu, Zaiseng, Zhuang Tulai, and others petitioned to submit. The court refused.

sentences.zh: 邊臣王見賓等復為請，詔復套部貢市。

translations.literal: Frontier officials Wang Jianbin and others again pleaded on their behalf; an edict restored the Ordos tribute markets.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials Wang Jianbin and others appealed again on their behalf. An edict restored the Ordos tribute markets.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，海部數入陝西塞，兵備副使李自實，總兵蕭如薰、達雲等擊走之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the Hai division repeatedly entered the Shaanxi frontier; defense vice commissioner Li Zishi, regional commanders Xiao Ruxun, Da Yun, and others struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the Hai division repeatedly penetrated the Shaanxi frontier. Defense vice commissioner Li Zishi and regional commanders Xiao Ruxun and Da Yun drove them back.

sentences.zh: 三十三年夏，東部宰賽誘殺慶雲堡守禦熊鑰，詔革其市賞。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirty-third year Zaisai of the eastern division lured and killed Qingyun Fort defense commandant Xiong Yao; an edict abolished their markets and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirty-third year Zaisai of the eastern division treacherously killed Qingyun Fort defense commandant Xiong Yao. An edict stripped him of his markets and rewards.

sentences.zh: 三十五年夏，總督徐三畏言：「河套之部與河東之部不同。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirty-fifth year grand secretary Xu Sanwei said: "The tribes of the River Bend differ from the tribes east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirty-fifth year grand secretary Xu Sanwei wrote: "The tribes of the Ordos loop differ from the tribes east of the river.

sentences.zh: 東部事統於一，約誓定，歷三十年不變。

translations.literal: The eastern division's affairs are unified under one head; covenants are fixed and have remained unchanged through thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern division answers to a single leader; its covenants were set thirty years ago and have held ever since.

sentences.zh: 套部分四十二枝，各相雄長，卜失兔徒建空名於上。

translations.literal: The Ordos division splits into forty-two branches, each vying as chief over the others; Bushitu merely erects an empty title above them.
translations.idiomatic: The Ordos divides into forty-two branches that vie with one another for supremacy. Bushitu holds only an empty title over them.

sentences.zh: 西則火落赤最狡，要挾最無厭；

translations.literal: In the west Huoluochi is most cunning; in demands and coercion he is most insatiable;
translations.idiomatic: In the west Huoluochi is the most cunning and insatiable in his demands;

sentences.zh: 中則擺言太以父明安之死，無歲不犯；

translations.literal: in the center Bai Yantai, because of his father Ming An's death, violates the frontier every year without exception;
translations.idiomatic: in the center Bai Yantai raids every year to avenge his father Ming An's death;

sentences.zh: 東則沙計爭為監市，與炒花朋逞。

translations.literal: in the east Shaji vies to serve as market overseer and runs rampant in league with Chao Hua.
translations.idiomatic: in the east Shaji fights to control the markets and runs wild alongside Chao Hua.

sentences.zh: 西陲搶攘非一日矣。

translations.literal: On the western frontier turmoil and scrambling are not of a single day's making.
translations.idiomatic: Turmoil on the western frontier has been building for years.

sentences.zh: 然眾雖號十萬，分為四十二枝，多者不過二三千騎，少者一二千騎耳。

translations.literal: Yet though their masses are said to number one hundred thousand, divided into forty-two branches, the larger have no more than two or three thousand horsemen and the smaller only one or two thousand horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Yet though they are said to number one hundred thousand, split among forty-two branches the largest counts no more than two or three thousand horsemen, the smallest only one or two thousand.

sentences.zh: 宜分其勢，納其款，俾先順者獲賞，後至者拒剿。

translations.literal: One should divide their power, accept their submissions, let those who submit first receive rewards, and those who come later be repelled and suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: We should divide their strength and accept their pledges—reward those who submit first and strike down those who hold back.

sentences.zh: 仍須主戰以張國威。

translations.literal: Still one must uphold fighting as the main policy to display national might.
translations.idiomatic: Even so we must keep war as the main policy to uphold the empire's prestige.

sentences.zh: 」時已許宰賽及火落赤諸部復貢市矣。

translations.literal: " At that time permission had already been granted for Zaisai and Huoluochi's divisions to resume tribute markets.
translations.idiomatic: " By then Zaisai and Huoluochi's divisions had already been allowed to resume their tribute markets.

sentences.zh: 未幾撦力剋死，未有嗣，忠順夫人率所部仍效貢職。

translations.literal: Before long Chelik died; there was no successor, and Lady of Loyal Submission led her division still to perform tribute duties.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Chelik died without an heir. Lady of Loyal Submission continued to lead her followers in performing tribute duties.

sentences.zh: 西部銀定、歹青數擁眾犯東西邊。

translations.literal: Yin Ding and Dai Qing of the western division repeatedly led hosts to violate the eastern and western frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Ding and Dai Qing of the western division repeatedly led large forces against both the eastern and western frontiers.

sentences.zh: 延綏部猛克什力亦以挾賞故，常沿邊抄掠。

translations.literal: Mengkeshili of the Yansui division also, because of demanding rewards, frequently raided and pillaged along the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Mengkeshili of the Yansui division also frequently raided the frontier, using extorted rewards as a pretext.

sentences.zh: 卜失兔欲婚於忠順，忠順拒之。

translations.literal: Bushitu wished to marry Lady of Loyal Submission; she refused him.
translations.idiomatic: Bushitu sought to marry Lady of Loyal Submission; she rebuffed him.

sentences.zh: 其所部素囊台吉、五路台吉等，各不相下，封號久未定。

translations.literal: Among his divisions Suonang Taiji, Wulu Taiji, and others each would not submit to the others; enfeoffments and titles had long gone unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinates Suonang Taiji, Wulu Taiji, and others each refused to yield to the others, and their titles and enfeoffments had long been unsettled.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，卜失兔始婚於忠順，東、西諸部長皆具狀為請封。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year Bushitu at last married Lady of Loyal Submission; chiefs of the eastern and western divisions all submitted written petitions requesting enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year Bushitu finally married Lady of Loyal Submission. Chiefs from the eastern and western divisions all filed formal petitions requesting enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 忠順夫人旋卒，詔封卜失兔為順義王，而以把漢比吉素效恭順，封忠義夫人。

translations.literal: Lady of Loyal Submission soon died; an edict enfeoffed Bushitu as Prince of Shun Righteousness, and because Bahen Bij had long been respectfully obedient, enfeoffed her as Lady of Loyal Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Lady of Loyal Submission soon died. An edict enfeoffed Bushitu as Prince of Shun Righteousness and, because Bahen Bij had long served loyally, enfeoffed her as Lady of Loyal Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 卜失兔為撦力克孫，襲封時，已少衰，所制止山、大二鎮外十二部。

translations.literal: Bushitu was Chelik's grandson; at the time he inherited the title he had already declined somewhat, and what he controlled was only the twelve divisions outside Shanshan and Da'er garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Bushitu was Chelik's grandson. By the time he inherited the title his power had already waned. He controlled only the twelve divisions outside the Shanshan and Da'er garrisons.

sentences.zh: 其部長五路、素囊及兀慎台吉等，兵力皆與順義埒。

translations.literal: His division chiefs Wulu, Suonang, and Wushen Taiji and others all had military strength equal to the Prince of Shun Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinate chiefs Wulu, Suonang, and Wushen Taiji and others commanded forces equal to the Prince's own.

sentences.zh: 朝廷因宣大總督涂宗浚言，各予升賞如例。

translations.literal: The court, following Xuan-Datong grand secretary Tu Zongjun's words, granted each promotions and rewards according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: At the recommendation of Xuan-Datong grand secretary Tu Zongjun, the court granted each the usual promotions and rewards.

sentences.zh: 其年，炒花糾虎墩兔三犯遼東。

translations.literal: That year Chao Hua gathered Hudun Tu and thrice violated Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chao Hua joined with Hudun Tu to raid Liaodong three times.

sentences.zh: 虎墩兔者，居插漢兒地，亦曰插漢兒王子，元裔也。

translations.literal: Hudun Tu dwelt in Cha Han'er territory, also called Prince of Cha Han'er, a descendant of the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hudun Tu—also known as the Prince of Cha Han—held the Cha Han lands and was a descendant of the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 其祖打來孫始駐牧宣塞外，俺答方強，懼為所並，乃徙帳於遼，收福余雜部，數入掠薊西，四傳至虎墩兔，遂益盛。

translations.literal: His ancestor Dalai Sun first pastured outside the Xuan frontier; when Altan was strong he feared being absorbed and therefore moved his camp to Liaodong, gathered the scattered Fuyu divisions, repeatedly entered to raid west of Ji, and through four generations down to Hudun Tu he grew ever more powerful.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor Dalai Sun first pastured beyond the Xuan frontier. When Altan was at his height he feared annexation and moved his camp to Liaodong, gathered the scattered Fuyu tribes, and repeatedly raided west of Ji. Four generations later Hudun Tu had grown still more powerful.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，炒花復合宰賽、暖兔以三萬騎入掠，至平虜、大寧。

translations.literal: The next summer Chao Hua again joined Zaisai and Nuantu with thirty thousand horsemen to enter and raid, reaching Pinglu and Daning.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer Chao Hua again joined Zaisai and Nuantu with thirty thousand horsemen in a raid that reached Pinglu and Daning.

sentences.zh: 既求撫賞，許之。

translations.literal: Having sought pacification rewards, this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: They then demanded pacification payments, and the court granted them.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，猛克什力寇懷遠及保寧。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year Mengkeshili raided Huaiyuan and Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year Mengkeshili raided Huaiyuan and Baoning.

sentences.zh: 延綏總兵官秉忠等破之。

translations.literal: Yansui regional commander Guan Bingzhong and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yansui regional commander Guan Bingzhong and his colleagues defeated them.

sentences.zh: 斬二百二十一級。

translations.literal: Two hundred twenty-one heads were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred twenty-one heads were taken.

sentences.zh: 明年，插部數犯遼東。

translations.literal: The next year the Cha division repeatedly violated Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Cha Han forces repeatedly struck Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 已，掠義州，攻陷大安堡，兵民死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Before long they raided Yizhou, stormed and took Da'an Fort, and soldiers and commoners who died were very many.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they raided Yizhou, stormed Da'an Fort, and killed a great many soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，總兵杜文煥數破套部猛克什力等於延綏邊，火落赤、擺言太及吉能、切盡、歹青、沙計東西諸部皆懼，先後來請貢市。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year regional commander Du Wenhuan repeatedly defeated Mengkeshili and others of the Ordos at the Yansui frontier; Huoluochi, Bai Yantai, and Jineng, Qiejin, Dai Qing, Shaji of the eastern and western divisions all feared and successively came to request tribute markets.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year regional commander Du Wenhuan repeatedly defeated Mengkeshili and other Ordos leaders on the Yansui frontier. Huoluochi, Bai Yantai, Jineng, Qiejin, Dai Qing, Shaji, and other eastern and western chiefs were all alarmed and came one after another to petition for tribute markets.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，我大清兵起，略撫順及開原，插部乘隙擁眾挾賞。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year our Great Qing army rose, overran Fushun and Kaiyuan; the Cha division seized the opportunity and led a host to demand rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year the Great Qing army rose and overran Fushun and Kaiyuan. The Cha Han forces seized the opportunity to gather their followers and extort rewards.

sentences.zh: 西部阿暈妻滿旦亦以萬騎自石塘路入掠薊鎮白馬關及高家、馮家諸堡。

translations.literal: Man Dan, wife of A Yun of the western division, also with ten thousand horsemen entered from the Shitang route to raid Baima Pass of Ji garrison and the forts of Gaojia, Fengjia, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Man Dan, wife of western chieftain A Yun, also led ten thousand horsemen through the Shitang route to raid Baima Pass in the Ji garrison and the forts of Gaojia, Fengjia, and others.

sentences.zh: 游擊硃萬良御之，被圍。

translations.literal: Guerrilla commander Zhu Wanliang defended against them and was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: Guerrilla commander Zhu Wanliang met them in battle and was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 羽書日數十至，中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: Urgent dispatches arrived by the dozens each day; court and countryside were on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Dozens of urgent dispatches arrived daily, and court and country alike went on high alert.

sentences.zh: 頃之，滿旦亦叩關乞通貢。

translations.literal: Before long Man Dan also came to the passes to knock and beg to open tribute relations.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Man Dan also came to the passes to petition for tribute relations.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，大清兵滅宰賽及北關金台什、布羊古等。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year the Great Qing army destroyed Zaisai and Beiguan chiefs Jintai Shi, Buyanggu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year the Great Qing army destroyed Zaisai and the northern pass chiefs Jintai Shi, Buyanggu, and others.

sentences.zh: 金台什孫女為虎墩兔婦，於是薊遼總督文球、巡撫周永春等以利啖之，俾聯結炒花諸部，以捍大清兵，給白金四千。

translations.literal: Jintai Shi's granddaughter was Hudun Tu's wife; thus Jizhou-Liaodong grand secretary Wen Qiu, grand coordinator Zhou Yongchun, and others used profit to entice him, causing him to unite with Chao Hua's divisions to resist the Great Qing army, and granted four thousand taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: Jintai Shi's granddaughter was Hudun Tu's wife. Jizhou-Liaodong grand secretary Wen Qiu, grand coordinator Zhou Yongchun, and others therefore bribed him to ally with Chao Hua's tribes against the Great Qing army, granting four thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 明年，為泰昌元年，加賞至四萬。

translations.literal: The next year, being the first year of Taichang, additional rewards were increased to forty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The following year—the first year of Taichang—the stipend was raised to forty thousand.

sentences.zh: 虎乃揚言助中國，邀索無厭。

translations.literal: The Tiger thereupon proclaimed aid to China and in demands and extortion was insatiable.
translations.idiomatic: Hudun Tu then declared he would aid China, but his demands proved insatiable.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年秋，吉能犯延綏邊，榆林總兵杜文煥擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Tianqi Jineng violated the Yansui frontier; Yulin regional commander Du Wenhuan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Tianqi Jineng struck the Yansui frontier. Yulin regional commander Du Wenhuan defeated him.

sentences.zh: 明年春，復大掠延安黃花峪，深入六百里，殺掠居民數萬。

translations.literal: The next spring they again raided on a great scale Huanghuayu in Yan'an, penetrating six hundred li deep, killing and plundering several tens of thousands of residents.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they again raided on a massive scale at Huanghuayu in Yan'an, penetrating six hundred li and killing or plundering tens of thousands of residents.

sentences.zh: 三年春，銀定糾眾再掠西邊，官軍擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year Yin Ding gathered followers to again raid the western frontier; government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year Yin Ding rallied his followers for another raid on the western frontier. Government troops defeated them.

sentences.zh: 明年春，復謀入故巢，犯松山，為守臣馮任等所敗。

translations.literal: The next spring they again plotted to enter their old nest, violated Songshan, and were defeated by defending officials Feng Ren and others.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they again tried to return to their old grounds and struck at Songshan. Garrison commander Feng Ren and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏，遂糾海西古六台吉等犯甘肅，總兵董繼舒擊之，斬三百餘級。

translations.literal: In summer they then gathered Haixi Gu Liu Taiji and others to violate Gansu; regional commander Dong Jishu struck them and beheaded more than three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they rallied Haixi Gu Liu Taiji and others to invade Gansu. Regional commander Dong Jishu met them and took more than three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 其年，歹青以領賞嘩於邊，邊人格殺之。

translations.literal: That year Dai Qing made a clamor at the frontier over receiving rewards; frontier men killed him on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: That year Dai Qing raised a disturbance at the frontier over his reward payment. Border men killed him on the spot.

sentences.zh: 歹青，虎墩兔近屬也，邊臣議歲給償命銀一萬三千有奇，而虎怏怏，益思飏去。

translations.literal: Dai Qing was Hudun Tu's close kinsman; frontier officials deliberated on granting yearly blood-money silver of a little more than thirteen thousand, yet the Tiger was discontent and all the more thought of fleeing away.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Qing was a close kinsman of Hudun Tu. Frontier officials proposed an annual blood-price payment of a little over thirteen thousand taels, but Hudun Tu was aggrieved and only grew more eager to break away.

sentences.zh: 未幾，大清兵襲破炒花，所部皆散亡，半歸於插漢。

translations.literal: Before long the Great Qing army raided and broke Chao Hua; his divisions all scattered and perished, half returning to Cha Han.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Great Qing army struck and shattered Chao Hua. His followers scattered, and half joined Cha Han.

sentences.zh: 時卜失兔益衰，號令不行於諸部，部長干兒罵等歲數犯延綏諸邊。

translations.literal: At this time Bushitu declined further; orders could not be enforced among the divisions; division chief Gan'erma and others year after year violated the Yansui frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: By then Bushitu had weakened further. His orders no longer carried among the tribes, and chiefs such as Gan'erma raided the Yansui frontier year after year.

sentences.zh: 七慶台吉及敖目比吉、毛乞炭比吉等，亦各擁眾往來窺伺塞下。

translations.literal: Qiqing Taiji and Aomu Bij, Maoqitan Bij, and others also each led hosts to come and go, watching and probing below the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing Taiji, Aomu Bij, Maoqitan Bij, and others also led their followers back and forth, probing along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年，虎墩兔攻哈喇嗔及白言台吉、卜失兔諸部，皆破之，遂乘勝入犯宣大塞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen Hudun Tu attacked Harachan and Baitai Taiji, Bushitu, and other divisions, all of which he broke; then riding victory he entered to violate the Xuan-Datong frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongzhen Hudun Tu attacked Harachan, Baitai Taiji, Bushitu, and their tribes and defeated them all. He then pressed his advantage and invaded the Xuan-Datong frontier.

sentences.zh: 秋，帝御平台，召總督王象乾，詢以方略，象乾對言：「御插之道，宜令其自相攻。

translations.literal: In autumn the emperor attended the platform, summoned grand secretary Wang Xiangqian, and inquired about strategy; Xiangqian replied saying: "The way to resist the Cha is to make them attack one another.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the emperor held court on the review platform and summoned grand secretary Wang Xiangqian to ask his strategy. Xiangqian replied: "The way to counter the Cha Han is to set them against one another.

sentences.zh: 今卜失兔西走套內，白台吉挺身免，而哈喇嗔所部多被擄，不足用。

translations.literal: Now Bushitu flees west into the Ordos interior, Baitai Taiji escaped by personal effort, and Harachan's divisions were mostly captured—not enough to be of use.
